title: Associate II, Pharmacovigilance - Brazil - Remote
description:
What the Associate II, Pharmacovigilance does at Worldwide


Responsible for the collection, processing, evaluation and reporting of incoming Serious Adverse Event (SAE) data according to applicable regulatory guidelines/requirements, Worldwide Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and project specific instructions. Serves as Lead PV Associate on moderate to large sized studies that are moderate to complex in scope of work with moderate support from senior staff.


What you will do


  • Author Safety Management Plan for assigned studies
  • Attend and present at Investigator Meetings
  • Review incoming SAE data for completeness and accuracy
  • Perform data entry in the Safety Database and/or complete applicable tracking of incoming safety information
  • Perform QC of SAEs processed by other PV Associates
  • Generate regulatory reports and perform safety submissions as needed


What you will bring to the role


  • Strong understanding of medical and scientific terminology, of the principles of clinical assessment of adverse drug events, of international regulations and of reporting requirements
  • Strong understanding of computer technology, and management of relational database systems, including extraction of data
  • Excellent organizational skills and ability to handle multiple competing priorities within tight timelines
  • Consistently demonstrates commitment, dependability, cooperation, adaptability and flexibility in executing daily tasks and responsibilities


Your experience


  • Minimum of 3 years of pharmacovigilance experience (pre-approval clinical trials)
  • Bachelor’s degree in science related field, nursing or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience
  • Computer literacy and strong working knowledge of MS Office applications (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Excellent organization skills and attention to detail
  • Demonstrated ability to handle multiple competing priorities while adhering to applicable timelines
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize work effectively and work successfully in matrix team environment
  • Ability and willingness for potential limited travel (domestic and international) as needed (attend Investigator Meeting, project kick-off meeting and/or bid defense meeting)
  • Fluent in written and verbal English

title: Community Manager – RoboNeo Brazil
description:
Why We Need You:

RoboNeo ( is landing in Brazil, and we're building a creator community that can turn AI-powered imagination into reality. As our Community Manager, you'll be the one finding brilliant creators, getting them hooked on our tools, and fueling a movement that drives real user growth. This isn't managing an existing group — you'll build it from scratch in one of the most explosive markets for generative AI video. You'll work closely with product, marketing, and growth teams across different countries, and pick up skills that are only going to get more valuable. If you love AI, content, and the chaos of building something new, this is your spot.


What You'll Do:

· Scout and win over top AI creators across Brazil — identify talented voices, reach out, and get them excited about what RoboNeo can do;

· Own the relationship from first hello to long-term partnership — run interviews, onboard new creators, and keep the vibe strong with the people who matter most;

· Be the bridge between the community and our product — gather feedback, spot patterns, and help creators solve their real challenges with RoboNeo;

· Build and run training that actually helps — design educational flows, share pro tips, and level up the quality of content the community puts out;

· Keep a finger on the pulse with data — track community health every week, pull reports, and turn numbers into smarter moves that boost engagement.


Who You Are:

· You've got 1+ years of hands-on experience in community management, influencer marketing, creator partnerships, or something similar;

· Portuguese is your native language (or C1+) and you breathe Brazilian internet culture — you know where creators hang out, what formats fly, and what feels fake a mile away;

· You're genuinely curious about AI and content creation — you'd jump at the chance to geek out over new tools and become a product expert;

· You're a people person for real — you enjoy connecting with creators, reading what makes them tick, and building relationships that last beyond a DM;

· Numbers don't scare you — you're comfortable digging into metrics to see what's working, what's not, and turning those insights into action;

· You're a self-starter who builds things from zero — you don't wait for a manual, you figure it out and make it happen in a fast, scrappy environment.


Even Better If You...

· You've already worked with creator or UGC communities in video or photo content;

· You've played around with AI content generation tools and know what \"good\" looks like;

· English proficiency is a plus.

title: Licensing Operations, & Financial Resolution Specialist
description:
Location: Brazil (100% Remote or Hybrid for Serra Gaúcha or São Paulo residents)

Compensation Currency: Brazilian Real (BRL)

Contract: Permanent Full Time (CLT) - 42h/week


About Us

Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,400+ employees and 70,000+ customers across 100+ countries. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end-to-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen & Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass & Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North & South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.

Cyncly brings over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end-to-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.

Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specialized in technology.


Role Purpose

This role ensures that customers receive the products, services, licences, and entitlements they have purchased — accurately and with minimal customer effort. The specialist resolves customer enquiries raised via Zendesk that relate to invoices, contracts in Salesforce, and related systems, acting as the operational owner for entitlement, billing, and data integrity matters within standard service levels.


Required Skills & Experience

  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce and NetSuite (the team's go-forward systems); willingness and ability to learn additional legacy systems as needed
  • Prior experience with a ticketing tool such as Zendesk is a plus but not required
  • High level of English, written and spoken — the role requires clear communication with global, internal stakeholders
  • Strong written communication skills and attention to detail
  • Comfortable working across multiple, sometimes unfamiliar, IT systems
  • Able to work under pressure and manage competing priorities
  • Strong team player who collaborates across Sales, Finance, Operations, and Support

Core Responsibilities Entitlement & Licensing Management

  • Accurately assign licences and service entitlements and rapidly activate new purchases
  • Manage upgrades, downgrades, renewals, and licensee transfers/reassignments
  • Monitor licence allocation and usage; identify under- or over-utilised licences
  • Verify customers have access to all products and services purchased; audit and reconcile entitlements
  • Resolve entitlement discrepancies and prevent access interruptions
  • Interpret contractual entitlement rights and validate product, support, and service eligibility
  • Ensure alignment between contracts, orders, invoices, and entitlement systems, including for complex enterprise agreements

Billing & Invoice Support

  • Own customer billing enquiries end-to-end via Zendesk tickets, from first response through resolution
  • Investigate disputed charges and resolve invoice discrepancies, explaining charges, credits, and taxes clearly
  • Raise credit note requests and provide first-level approval of credit notes raised by other areas
  • Validate contract pricing and entitlements against billing records
  • Handle invoice, statement, and contract copy requests

Data Quality & Master Data Management

  • Maintain the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of customer, billing, and entitlement records
  • Identify and resolve data discrepancies and remove duplicate records
  • Validate data against source systems (Salesforce, NetSuite, and other platforms) and contractual agreements
  • Coordinate master data updates across CRM, billing, licensing, and support platforms
  • Process changes in billing frequency, currency, and historical contract corrections

Reconciliation, Change & Escalation Management

  • Reconcile data between systems and investigate root causes of mismatches
  • Support customer mergers, acquisitions, and organisational/account hierarchy changes
  • Coordinate with Sales, Operations, Finance, and Technical Support on business-critical issues
  • Own priority investigation and escalation of entitlement and data issues within defined SLAs

Reporting

  • Contribute to entitlement summaries, licence position, and renewal/expiry reporting (with the BI team)
  • Support data quality scorecards, customer data health assessments, and root-cause reporting

Service Expectations

  • Proactive: Monitor upcoming expirations and data anomalies; flag gaps before they affect the customer
  • Accurate: Get entitlement and data changes right first time, with full traceability
  • Responsive: Provide timely, reliable resolution within standard SLAs
  • Transparent: Give clear visibility into issue status, ownership, and resolution

title: Head of Business & Operations (Brazil Resident)
description:
About the company

We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets. Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. With thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally, we operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments. We are building the financial infrastructure of the next era of the internet.


Why this role

We are entering the Brazilian market as a Banco Central do Brasil-authorised Virtual Asset Service Provider, and you would be our first Business & Operations Officer on the ground. Under BCB Resolution 520/2025, VASPs are required to designate a statutory director responsible for conducting the institution's business and ensuring alignment with its commercial and strategic objectives — this is that seat. In your first year, you will have established the operational foundation of Gate's Brazil entity, built the company's commercial presence in the market, and ensured our business activities run in full alignment with the BCB's regulatory expectations.


What you'll do

  • Hold statutory director responsibility for business conduct and operations at a BCB-authorised VASP, with personal accountability for acting in good faith and in the company's best interest
  • Oversee and conduct the institution's day-to-day business activities, ensuring alignment with Gate's commercial strategy and operational objectives in Brazil
  • Act as the primary operational interface between Gate's Brazil entity and its regional and global leadership, translating strategic direction into local execution
  • Maintain personal fitness and propriety; disclose, without prompting, anything that touches your fitness, propriety, or potential conflicts — to the company and to the BCB
  • Drive the VASP authorisation process forward on the business and operations workstream, including declarations and documentation the BCB requests on its own timeline
  • Discharge any additional duties prescribed by applicable Brazilian laws, regulations, or by the company


What you'll bring

Must-have

  • Brazilian permanent residency or citizenship , with the ability to maintain ordinary residency in Brazil for as long as the role requires
  • You hold no competing statutory director or officer seat at another regulated entity in Brazil
  • A predominantly commercial and operational profile — you have led or co-led a business unit, market expansion, or operational function, not just supported one
  • Prior experience at a BCB-regulated financial institution, fintech, or crypto/VASP — familiarity with how regulated entities operate in Brazil is essential
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English, written and spoken
  • Willing to undergo a full BCB fit-and-proper review and disclose what it requires


Nice-to-have

  • Prior experience in the crypto or digital asset industry
  • Direct prior engagement with BCB on regulatory filings, inspections, or authorisation processes
  • Academic background or postgraduate training in business, finance, economics, or law

title: Direct Response Ads | Video Editor
description:
About Hydroh:


We’re one of the fastest-growing Shopify-based DTC brands in the world at the forefront of all things hydrogen water.


Our product line includes hydrogen water bottles, supplements, and accessories all designed to help people recover faster, reduce inflammation, and feel their best.


We’re looking for a Performance Video Editor who deeply understands how to cut direct response ads for Meta (Facebook/Instagram), TikTok, and YouTube Shorts. This is NOT a branding video role we’re talking scroll-stopping hooks, retention-driven pacing, and revenue-first editing.


Compensation & Perks:

  • Base Salary + Performance Bonus (Depending on experience and skillset)
  • Full-Time, 40 hours per week (Flexible Schedule just a few hours overlap with EST is fine)
  • Fully Remote
  • Resources, trainings, and courses covered we invest in our people.


What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years experience editing direct response video ads for DTC brands
  • Portfolio of paid ads you've edited (Meta, TikTok, YT Shorts — performance-focused)
  • Advanced skills in Adobe Premiere, After Effects, or equivalent
  • Strong understanding of performance editing — you know what makes a video convert
  • Experience editing UGC-style content, influencer videos, and testimonial formats
  • Ability to follow creative briefs and storyboards, but also contribute your own ideas
  • Comfortable with iterating quickly based on feedback and performance data
  • Clear communicator and proactive with timelines


Bonus Points:

  • Experience working with health & wellness or skincare brands
  • Familiarity with tools like Frame.io, Slack, and Notion
  • Understanding of hooks, angles, and stages of awareness
  • Editing for long-form VSLs


What you'll be doing:

  • Edit short-form performance videos (15–90 seconds) optimized for Meta and TikTok
  • Implement scroll-stopping hooks, fast-paced edits, dynamic subtitles, and retention overlays
  • Work closely with our Creative Strategist and UGC Project Manager to execute on weekly ad briefs
  • Repurpose UGC content, testimonials, and influencer clips into winning ad angles
  • Apply performance data to iterate and improve ad creatives week over week
  • Deliver assets fast we move quickly and expect tight turnaround when needed



We’re looking to hire immediately — so if you’re an editor who gets performance, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Estagiario de Lingua Itáliana
description:
Você é apaixonado pela língua e cultura italiana e quer ganhar experiência prática? Estamos em busca de um talento para apoiar nosso time de forma dinâmica e totalmente digital!

O que oferecemos:

  • Modalidade: 100% Home Office (aberto para estudantes de qualquer lugar do Brasil).
  • Carga Horária: 20 horas semanais (horário a combinar).
  • Bolsa Auxílio: R$ 1.000,00 + Auxílio Home Office.

Principais Atividades:

  • Apoio na elaboração e revisão de materiais didáticos/conteúdos em italiano.
  • Auxílio em atividades de tradução e revisão de textos simples.
  • Suporte em aulas ou projetos culturais voltados ao idioma.
  • Atendimento/interação com alunos ou clientes no idioma.

Requisitos:

  • Estar cursando Letras (Português/Italiano) ou curso correlato que permita a assinatura de termo de compromisso de estágio.
  • Nível de italiano a partir do pré -intermediário ao avançado (B1 a C2).
  • Boa escrita e comunicação em português e italiano.
  • Organização para trabalhar de forma autônoma e remota.

Desejável:

  • Vivência internacional ou certificação de proficiência (CILS, CELI, PLIDA).

title: Product Analyst – Vmake · Brazil
description:
Why We Need You

We’re building an AI-powered video creation platform that empowers creators, brands, and e-commerce sellers to produce high-performing content with ease. As our Product Analyst, you’ll combine product thinking, user research, and data-driven insights to help shape features that resonate with Brazilian creators.


You’ll work closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers, and the creator community to identify opportunities, validate ideas, and ensure our product solves real user problems. Your understanding of short-form video trends, creator workflows, and AI-powered content creation will directly influence our product roadmap.


What You’ll Do

  • Become a power user of Vmake’s AI video tools by testing new features, identifying usability issues, and evaluating the overall creator experience.
  • Analyze user behavior, creator feedback, and product metrics to uncover opportunities for product improvements.
  • Monitor trends across TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, TikTok Shop, Amazon, Shopify, and emerging creator platforms, translating market insights into actionable product recommendations.
  • Partner with Product Managers to define product requirements, prioritize enhancements, and support roadmap planning.
  • Conduct competitive research on AI-powered creative tools and video editing platforms, identifying best practices and product gaps.
  • Gather, organize, and synthesize qualitative and quantitative user feedback into clear product recommendations.
  • Collaborate closely with Design and Engineering teams throughout feature discovery, testing, and iteration.
  • Assist in defining success metrics and evaluating feature performance after launch.
  • Create documentation including product briefs, user stories, competitive analyses, and feature specifications.


Who You Are

  • 3–5 years of experience in Product, Product Analysis, Product Operations, or a related product role within SaaS, AI, creator economy, social media, or e-commerce technology.
  • Strong understanding of the Brazilian creator ecosystem and short-form video platforms.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered creative tools and enthusiasm for generative AI technologies.
  • Experience translating customer pain points into clear product requirements.
  • Strong analytical thinking with the ability to interpret both qualitative and quantitative data.
  • Excellent communication skills and experience working cross-functionally with Product, Design, and Engineering.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with changing priorities.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Active content creator with a public portfolio or social media presence.
  • Experience with TikTok Shop, Amazon, Shopify, or creator-focused commerce platforms.
  • Experience conducting user interviews, usability testing, or product discovery.
  • Familiarity with wireframing tools such as Figma.
  • Experience using analytics tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, GA4, or similar platforms.

title: Associate Product Analyst – Vmake · Brazil
description:
Why We Need You

We’re looking for an enthusiastic Associate Product Analyst who is passionate about AI, creator tools, and short-form video. This is an excellent opportunity for someone early in their product career to learn from experienced product leaders while helping improve the experience for creators and e-commerce sellers across Brazil.


You’ll help gather customer insights, test new features, research market trends, and support product decisions that shape the future of AI-powered video creation.


What You’ll Do

  • Test new product features and provide structured feedback from the perspective of creators and online sellers.
  • Monitor trends across TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and creator economy platforms.
  • Conduct competitive research on AI video editing tools and summarize key findings.
  • Collect and organize customer feedback from multiple sources, identifying recurring themes and user pain points.
  • Support Product Managers in writing user stories, documenting product requirements, and maintaining product documentation.
  • Participate in feature testing, bug reporting, and quality validation before releases.
  • Help analyze product performance metrics and prepare reports for stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with Product, Design, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to improve the overall user experience.
  • Stay current on emerging AI technologies and creator economy trends.


Who You Are

  • 1–3 years of experience in Product, Business Analysis, Product Operations, Customer Experience, Digital Marketing, or a related field.
  • Strong interest in AI products, content creation, and the creator economy.
  • Familiarity with TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, or similar short-form video platforms.
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills.
  • Curious, proactive, and eager to learn product development methodologies.
  • Comfortable working with cross-functional teams and adapting to a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Personal experience creating content for social media platforms.
  • Exposure to AI-powered creative tools.
  • Familiarity with Agile product development.
  • Experience with basic analytics, spreadsheets, or data visualization tools.
  • Portfolio or social media profile showcasing your understanding of digital content is a plus.

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Expert for Digital Marketing Agency
description:
About Vysta Paid Media Group

Vysta is a pay-for-performance digital marketing agency specializing in Google Ads, YouTube Ads, creative development, and landing page optimization. With over eight years of experience and $1.5B million in ROI generated for our clients, we've helped more than 200 businesses scale through data-driven growth strategies.

As we continue to grow, we're seeking a Talent Acquisition Specialist to lead the charge in sourcing and onboarding top-tier Media Buyers and Account Managers who will directly drive client success and campaign performance.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own the full-cycle recruitment process for Media Buyers and Account Managers
  • Develop and execute sourcing strategies across platforms like LinkedIn, job boards, and industry-specific communities
  • Write compelling job descriptions and recruitment content that reflect our high-performance culture
  • Screen, interview, and assess candidates for culture fit, technical ability, and alignment with our client-first mission
  • Coordinate hiring processes with internal leadership and hiring managers
  • Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline for ongoing and future hiring needs
  • Provide a seamless and professional candidate experience
  • Maintain recruitment metrics and improve hiring funnel efficiency

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in recruiting or talent acquisition, preferably in a digital marketing or agency environment
  • Proven success recruiting Media Buyers, Account Managers, or similar roles in performance marketing
  • Deep understanding of ad agency roles and what makes a high-performing candidate
  • Excellent sourcing skills and familiarity with tools like LinkedIn Recruiter, Workable, or Greenhouse
  • Strong communication and organizational skills
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, remote-first environment
  • Self-starter mindset with a results-driven approach

Why Vysta?

  • Performance-first culture with real impact from every hire
  • Fully remote with a flexible, fast-moving work environment
  • Opportunity to shape the growth of a high-velocity agency
  • Work closely with leadership on strategic hiring priorities
  • Transparent, data-informed, and execution-oriented team culture

Join us and rewrite how the world engages at scale.


Associate Level

Location: Brazil

Prior Experience in SaaS/ Software Industry is preferred

Language: Spanish and business-level fluency in English

title: JDE Functional Finance Lead
description:
We’re looking for an experienced JDE Functional Finance Lead to join our team and play a key role in supporting and optimizing JD Edwards Financial processes. This role is ideal for a hands-on finance systems professional with strong functional expertise in GL, AP, Tax, and regulatory compliance .


Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead and support JD Edwards (JDE) Financial modules , including GL, AP, AR, Fixed Assets, and Tax
  • Partner with Finance, Tax, Audit, and IT teams to ensure accurate and compliant financial processes
  • Translate business requirements into functional system solutions
  • Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities
  • Ensure compliance with financial regulations, tax rules, and internal controls
  • Lead testing (UAT), enhancements, and system improvements
  • Provide functional guidance, training, and ongoing support to finance users
  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and automate financial processes


Required Skills and Experience:

  • Strong functional experience with JD Edwards Financials
  • Proven expertise in General Ledger, Accounts Payable, and Tax
  • Solid understanding of financial regulations and compliance
  • Experience leading or supporting JDE implementations or upgrades
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with technical and business teams
  • Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or Information Systems
  • Experience in multi-entity or multi-country financial environments
  • Prior experience as a functional lead or subject matter expert

title: UX Designer Pleno - 135300
description:
O que buscamos:

Profissional Pleno que atue com UX Design.


Atuação remota e Contratação CLT


Responsabilidades:


  • Execução de Design: Criar fluxos de usuário, wireframes, protótipos de baixa a alta fidelidade e especificações de interface.
  • Pesquisa com Usuários: Conduzir testes de usabilidade, entrevistas qualitativas e aplicar pesquisas sob a supervisão e alinhamento do time.
  • Apoio à Estratégia: Traduzir os direcionamentos estratégicos do time em entregáveis tangíveis para o produto.
  • Documentação: Manter o Design System atualizado e documentar decisões de design.
  • Colaboração: Trabalhar junto com times de produto, engenharia e QA durante todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência comprovada em UX Design (nível pleno).
  • Domínio de ferramentas de design e prototipagem (Figma).
  • Experiência prática na criação de fluxos, personas, wireframes e protótipos.
  • Vivência na condução de testes de usabilidade e pesquisas básicas com usuários.
  • Compreensão sólida de Design Systems e acessibilidade digital (WCAG).


Diferenciais:


  • Experiência em produtos digitais complexos ou B2B.
  • Conhecimento básico de métricas de produto (KPIs como retenção, conversão, NPS).
  • Noções de front-end (HTML/CSS) para facilitar o diálogo com desenvolvedores.
  • Facilidade em trabalhar em ambientes ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Domínio de engenharia de prompt aplicados ao fluxo de design.
  • Uso prático de ferramentas de IA (como ChatGPT, Midjourney, Claude ou ferramentas nativas do Figma) para acelerar processos de tomada de decisão e geração de ideias.
  • Vivência em design apoiado por IA (AI-assisted design) para criação de layouts, testes automatizados ou análise de dados de uso.


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Ser comunicativo com o perfil questionador e proativo.
  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.



Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.

title: ServiceNow Business Analyst (Now Assist AI)
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


We are looking for a ServiceNow Business Analyst (Now Assist AI) who wants to learn and transform his/her career.


Requirements:

• 7+ years of experience as a Business Analyst.

• Advanced to Fluent English with the ability to host meetings with US stakeholders.

• Proven experience as a Business Analyst with expertise in the ServiceNow platform.

• Hands-on experience delivering AI-driven projects.

• Good understanding of ServiceNow Now Assist, Generative AI, and LLM technologies.

• Experience with ServiceNow App Engine Studio.

• Experience building Service Catalogs and business applications.

• Strong understanding of ITIL processes and best practices.

• Experience working in Agile environments (Scrum/Kanban).

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Ability to collaborate with both technical and non-technical teams.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong organizational and documentation skills.

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, or a related field.


Nice to Have:

• Experience with ServiceNow configuration and customization.

• Experience with AI-powered ServiceNow solutions.

• Knowledge of digital transformation initiatives.

• Experience within Utilities or Energy industry.

• ServiceNow certifications.

• Product Owner or Agile certifications.


Key Responsibilities:

• Gather, analyze, and document business requirements for ServiceNow initiatives.

• Work closely with stakeholders to identify opportunities for automation and process improvements.

• Translate business requirements into functional specifications and solution designs.

• Partner with technical teams to deliver ServiceNow and Now Assist AI solutions.

• Support the configuration and customization of ServiceNow applications.

• Create test plans, execute testing activities, and validate delivered solutions.

• Provide training and support to end users.

• Maintain documentation, process flows, user guides, and business requirements.

• Coordinate project activities and support successful solution delivery.

• Drive adoption of ServiceNow capabilities and AI-powered features.

• Identify opportunities for continuous improvement and process optimization.

• Act as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams.


Preferred Certifications:

• ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA).

• ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS).

• ServiceNow Micro-Certifications.

• PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP).

• Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO).

• ITIL Foundation v4.

title: Solutions Architect – Google Cloud (GCP)
description:
Descrição da vaga:

Buscamos um(a) Cloud Architect – Google Cloud (GCP) com perfil altamente técnico e vocação para ensino e evangelização.

Essa pessoa atuará principalmente na capacitação de clientes e equipes , conduzindo treinamentos, workshops e apresentações técnicas em toda a América Latina. O foco não é atuação diária em projetos ou pré-vendas, mas sim disseminação de conhecimento, apoio consultivo e desenvolvimento de conteúdos técnicos que impulsionem a adoção de soluções em Google Cloud Platform.

O perfil ideal combina experiência sólida em arquitetura de soluções em GCP com excelente comunicação, didática e capacidade de influenciar diferentes públicos.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Conduzir treinamentos técnicos, workshops e palestras (principalmente em espanhol) sobre GCP;
  • Desenvolver demonstrações práticas (hands-on) e provas de conceito (PoCs) para fins educacionais;
  • Apoiar clientes e parceiros na compreensão e adoção de soluções em GCP;
  • Desenhar arquiteturas de referência escaláveis, resilientes e seguras;
  • Atuar como referência técnica na disseminação de boas práticas em cloud;
  • Produzir e manter materiais técnicos, apresentações e conteúdos educacionais atualizados;
  • Apoiar iniciativas de modernização de aplicações e transformação digital;
  • Compartilhar tendências e inovações em cloud, serverless e cloud-native;
  • Interagir com stakeholders técnicos e de negócio em toda a América Latina.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiência sólida com Google Cloud Platform (GCP);
  • Experiência em arquitetura de soluções em cloud;
  • Vivência com modernização de aplicações e arquiteturas cloud-native e serverless;
  • Conhecimento prático em serviços GCP como: Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Cloud Storage, Compute Engine, VPC, IAM, Load Balancing, Cloud Monitoring e Logging;
  • Experiência com containers e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes / GKE);
  • Conhecimento em Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform);
  • Experiência com CI/CD e práticas de DevOps;
  • Vivência com migração de ambientes para cloud;
  • Conhecimento em redes (networking) e ambientes Linux;
  • Experiência com observabilidade e monitoramento;
  • Conhecimento em APIs e API Management;
  • Espanhol avançado para condução de treinamentos e apresentações.


Desejáveis:

  • Firebase;
  • BigQuery, Pub/Sub e Dataflow;
  • Apigee;
  • Anthos;
  • Cloud SQL e Memorystore;
  • Vertex AI (AI/ML em GCP);
  • Looker;
  • Kafka;
  • GitOps (ArgoCD);
  • Istio;
  • FinOps;
  • Práticas de SRE;
  • Segurança em cloud.

title: Analista de processos
description:
Sobre a Empresa

Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo: Analista de Processos


Responsabilidades:

• Conduzir reuniões de levantamento de requisitos.

• Elaborar especificações funcionais e técnicas.

• Modelar processos AS IS e TO BE.

• Gerenciar backlog funcional.

• Escrever critérios de aceite e histórias de usuário.

• Participar das cerimônias ágeis.

• Validar requisitos com stakeholders.

• Apoiar homologações (UAT).

• Identificar impactos em processos existentes.

• Atualizar documentação durante todo o ciclo do projeto.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Profissional com experiência mínima de 3 anos como analista de processos.
  • Domínio de técnica representação gráficas de processos, por meio de fluxogramas e BPMN, de processos em situação atual (AS IS) e situação futura (TO BE).
  • Capacidade de realizar diagnóstico e propor plano de ação.
  • Capacidade analítica , dando possibilidade de elaborar indicadores com os dados coletados.
  • Capacidade de apoiar a implementação de processos e realizar o fluxo de melhoria contínua (PDCA).


100% Remota


Todas as nossas oportunidades de trabalho estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

Apoiamos a diversidade!

title: Engenharia de Dados AWS Pleno/Sênior
description:
Sobre a vaga


Com mais de 35 anos de mercado e localizada em 16 países, a GFT emprega mais de 10.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo 3.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que estamos buscando?


  • Projetar, implementar e manter arquiteturas em nuvem AWS escaláveis, seguras e de alta performance
  • Automatizar provisionamento e gestão de infraestrutura utilizando Terraform e/ou CloudFormation (IaC)
  • Monitorar, otimizar desempenho, custos e segurança dos ambientes cloud
  • Definir e implementar boas práticas de autenticação, autorização, criptografia e governança
  • Apoiar squads de desenvolvimento e operações na implementação e evolução de pipelines CI/CD
  • Garantir alta disponibilidade , resiliência, disaster recovery e observabilidade dos sistemas
  • Criar e manter documentação técnica detalhada das arquiteturas e soluções implementadas
  • Atuar na resolução de incidentes críticos e na melhoria contínua dos ambientes em nuvem


Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada em AWS abrangendo serviços de compute (EC2, Lambda), storage (S3, EBS, EFS), networking (VPC, Route 53, Direct Connect), segurança, bancos de dados (RDS, DynamoDB, Aurora), análise e monitoramento
  • Domínio sólido em Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) – preferencialmente Terraform e/ou AWS CloudFormation
  • Experiência prática com pipelines CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline/CodeBuild/CodeDeploy)
  • Conhecimento avançado em automação e scripting (Python, Bash/Shell, PowerShell)
  • Forte vivência em segurança na nuvem (IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager, VPC peering/endpoints, Security Groups, AWS Organizations, encryption at rest/transit)
  • Familiaridade com containerização e orquestração (Docker, Amazon ECS, EKS ou Kubernetes nativo)
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (Amazon CloudWatch, X-Ray, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog ou similares)
  • Boa comunicação técnica e habilidade para colaborar com equipes de dev, ops, segurança e negócio



Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.


O que oferecemos:


Cartão multi-benefícios – você escolhe como e onde utilizar;

Bolsas de Estudos para cursos de Graduação, Pós, MBA e Idiomas;

Programas de incentivo à Certificações;

Plano personalizado de carreira e possibilidade de carreira internacional;

Salários competitivos;

Avaliação de desempenho anual com possibilidade de bonificação;

Gympass;

Previdência Privada;

Auxílio-Creche;

title: Email Designer
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle: from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

As an Email Designer at Lilo Social, you will be the creative force behind high-converting email experiences for our portfolio of direct-to-consumer brands. You will transform strategic concepts into beautiful, mobile-optimized email designs that drive engagement, revenue, and long-term customer loyalty. Working closely with retention strategists and copywriters, you will craft email templates that balance brand aesthetics with performance-driven design principles.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently high email engagement rates (open rates, click rates) across your client portfolio through strong visual design
  • Efficient production workflows that allow rapid iteration and testing of design variations
  • Email designs that maintain brand consistency while optimizing for conversion and user experience
  • Positive client feedback on design quality and strong collaboration with cross-functional team members


Responsibilities

  • Create campaign emails, automated flow templates, and promotional designs aligned with client brand guidelines
  • Develop mobile-first email designs that render flawlessly across email clients and devices
  • Collaborate with retention strategists and copywriters to bring campaign concepts to life
  • Iterate quickly on email designs based on performance data and A/B test results
  • Maintain organized design systems and asset libraries for each client account
  • Build reusable email modules and components that streamline production
  • Ensure all emails meet accessibility standards and deliverability best practices
  • Stay current on email design trends, platform updates, and industry innovations
  • Execute QA testing across multiple email clients before campaign launches
  • Support the team with design feedback and contribute to internal design standards
  • Manage multiple client accounts with varying design needs and brand aesthetics


Requirements

  • 2-4 years of experience in email design, digital design, or related field with a strong portfolio demonstrating email work
  • Expert proficiency in Figma for designing email layouts and creating design systems
  • Strong grasp of email marketing best practices including mobile optimization, CTA placement, and visual hierarchy
  • Demonstrated ability to design for conversion while maintaining brand integrity and aesthetic quality
  • Fast iteration speed with ability to produce high-quality work under tight timelines
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to pixel-perfect execution across devices
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with strategists, copywriters, and account teams
  • Familiarity with direct-to-consumer brands and ecommerce customer lifecycle marketing


Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with Klaviyo or other email service platforms (Mailchimp, Iterable, Braze)
  • Motion graphics or animation capabilities to enhance email interactivity and engagement
  • Experience designing for SMS, push notifications, or other retention marketing channels
  • Understanding of email deliverability factors and how design choices impact inbox placement


Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

The Role

As an Email Designer at Lilo Social, you will be the creative force behind high-converting email experiences for our portfolio of direct-to-consumer brands. You will transform strategic concepts into beautiful, mobile-optimized email designs that drive engagement, revenue, and long-term customer loyalty. Working closely with retention strategists and copywriters, you will craft email templates that balance brand aesthetics with performance-driven design principles.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently high email engagement rates (open rates, click rates) across your client portfolio through strong visual design
  • Efficient production workflows that allow rapid iteration and testing of design variations
  • Email designs that maintain brand consistency while optimizing for conversion and user experience
  • Positive client feedback on design quality and strong collaboration with cross-functional team members


Responsibilities

  • Create campaign emails, automated flow templates, and promotional designs aligned with client brand guidelines
  • Develop mobile-first email designs that render flawlessly across email clients and devices
  • Collaborate with retention strategists and copywriters to bring campaign concepts to life
  • Iterate quickly on email designs based on performance data and A/B test results
  • Maintain organized design systems and asset libraries for each client account
  • Build reusable email modules and components that streamline production
  • Ensure all emails meet accessibility standards and deliverability best practices
  • Stay current on email design trends, platform updates, and industry innovations
  • Execute QA testing across multiple email clients before campaign launches
  • Support the team with design feedback and contribute to internal design standards
  • Manage multiple client accounts with varying design needs and brand aesthetics


Requirements

  • 2-4 years of experience in email design, digital design, or related field with a strong portfolio demonstrating email work
  • Expert proficiency in Figma for designing email layouts and creating design systems
  • Strong grasp of email marketing best practices including mobile optimization, CTA placement, and visual hierarchy
  • Demonstrated ability to design for conversion while maintaining brand integrity and aesthetic quality
  • Fast iteration speed with ability to produce high-quality work under tight timelines
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to pixel-perfect execution across devices
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with strategists, copywriters, and account teams
  • Familiarity with direct-to-consumer brands and ecommerce customer lifecycle marketing


Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with Klaviyo or other email service platforms (Mailchimp, Iterable, Braze)
  • Motion graphics or animation capabilities to enhance email interactivity and engagement
  • Experience designing for SMS, push notifications, or other retention marketing channels
  • Understanding of email deliverability factors and how design choices impact inbox placement


Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Arquitetura de Soluções Azure - 134713
description:
O que buscamos:

Profissional de nível Arquitetura que atue com Cloud Azure) para atuação remota e contratação CLT.

Responsabilidades:

  • Fundar o ambiente Azure dentro do ecossistema multicloud do ZeroLayer Platform, projetando o modelo de isolamento entre células (shard key, blast radius e static stability) e implementando o Control Plane (shard map, registro de tenants e lifecycle de células).
  • Implementar o ZeroLayer Router HTTP (autenticação, TLS e lookup do shard map) e o ZeroLayer Router Kafka (isolamento de tópicos por tenant), definindo estratégia de autenticação sem lock-in (OIDC, mTLS).
  • Definir engines relacionais e não relacionais por célula, projetando sharding alinhado ao tenant key, com réplicas, failover e criptografia em repouso e trânsito de forma agnóstica ao provider.
  • Estabelecer padrões de IaC (Terraform) com módulos reutilizáveis por célula e desenhar pipeline CI/CD completo (lint, plan, gates de aprovação, apply e drift detection), suportando o ciclo completo da célula (criação, atualização, re-shard e destruição rastreável).
  • Provisionar AKS por célula com isolamento de rede e Network Policies, projetar topologia de VNet (subnets, peering, conectividade cross-cloud) e gerenciar ciclo de vida de certificados TLS de forma automatizada.
  • Implementar autenticação com provider agnóstico (OIDC/OAuth 2.0), configurar identidades gerenciadas sem segredos estáticos e estabelecer RBAC por célula com princípio de menor privilégio.
  • Implementar estratégia de observabilidade por célula (métricas, logs e traces distribuídos), operando Datadog como plataforma principal (APM, Log Management, dashboards e alertas baseados em SLO), garantindo rastreabilidade ponta a ponta com correlation IDs.
  • Documentar decisões em ADRs e diagramas de arquitetura.


Requisitos Obrigatórios


  • Larga experiência em Arquitetura de Soluções, Arquitetura de Software ou Cloud Architecture.
  • Experiência prática em arquitetura Azure e implementação de soluções em cloud.
  • Arquitetura de microsserviços utilizando Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
  • Arquitetura Celular, Control Plane, Data Plane e Shard Map.
  • Experiência com Cell-Based Architecture em produção.
  • APIs REST, gRPC e arquitetura baseada em contratos.
  • Arquiteturas orientadas a eventos utilizando plataformas como Kafka, Event Hubs ou equivalentes.
  • Bancos relacionais, NoSQL, cache distribuído e estratégias de sharding.
  • OAuth2, OpenID Connect e provedores modernos de identidade.
  • Observabilidade distribuída (logs, métricas, tracing e SLOs).
  • Architecture Reviews e elaboração de ADRs.
  • Experiência no setor Financeiro


Desejável:


  • Experiência com Zero-Failure Architecture.
  • CQRS.
  • Event Sourcing.
  • Saga Pattern.
  • Outbox Pattern.
  • Consumer Driven Contracts.
  • GraphQL.
  • Apache Pulsar, RabbitMQ ou outras plataformas de mensageria.
  • Java, Go ou .NET.
  • Experiência em ambientes multicloud (Azure e AWS).
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305).
  • Outras certificações Microsoft Azure (AZ-104, AZ-204, AI-102).
  • TOGAF.
  • Participação em pré-vendas técnicas ou definição de arquiteturas corporativas.
  • Conhecimento de Terraform


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;

title: Country Manager
description:
Position Description

1.Market Growth & Business Ownership

  • Own business growth and key market performance for the region, with clear accountability for business outcomes and growth metrics.
  • Analyze market performance, user behavior, and competitive landscape to identify growth opportunities and provide strategic insights to global teams.

2.User Growth & Market Development

  • Build the local market from 0 to 1 by developing scalable user acquisition and growth programs.
  • Drive organic user acquisition through localized social media, KOLs, creator programs, online communities, partnerships, and other community-led initiatives.
  • Increase Tripo's local presence, ecosystem penetration, and user touchpoints across both online and offline channels.

3.Creator Ecosystem & Community

  • Recruit, engage, and retain creators, studios, agencies, and other ecosystem partners.
  • Design creator programs, incentive systems, and community initiatives that strengthen long-term engagement and ecosystem growth.
  • Develop a deep understanding of creator workflows and translate creator feedback into product improvements and business opportunities.

4.Partnerships & Ecosystem Development

  • Build strategic relationships with KOLs, creator communities, educational institutions, media, industry organizations, and ecosystem partners.
  • Expand Tripo's presence within the local creative, AI, and 3D ecosystem through long-term partnerships.
  • Identify partnership opportunities that accelerate user growth and long-term ecosystem development.

5.Localization & Brand Presence

  • Localize messaging, campaigns, and content to better resonate with local creators and users.
  • Manage regional social channels and collaborate with the global marketing team on localized campaigns and paid creative assets.
  • Represent Tripo at conferences, workshops, meetups, creator events, and other industry activities

6.Cross-functional Leadership

  • Serve as the bridge between local users and global Product, Marketing, Growth, and Operations teams.
  • Deliver structured market reporting and recommendations to help shape product roadmap and go-to-market strategy.


Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in market operations, growth, business development, community, or ecosystem development, preferably in AI, SaaS, gaming, 3D, developer tools, or the creator economy.
  • Strong ownership mindset with accountability for business performance and measurable market growth.
  • Proven experience building markets from 0 to 1 and driving user growth through social media, KOLs, creator communities, partnerships, and other organic growth channels.
  • Deep understanding of local markets, creator ecosystems, and community operations.
  • Good understanding of both consumer (B2C) growth and small business (SMB) customer acquisition and engagement.
  • Data-driven, strategic, and capable of turning insights into actionable business initiatives.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills; bilingual or multilingual candidates are preferred.
  • Entrepreneurial, hands-on, and comfortable operating in ambiguity—from strategy to execution, from growth initiatives to event logistics.

title: Segment Manager
description:
Position Details

Job Title: Antenna Sales Manager

Department: Sales — Latin America

Reports To: Regional Sales Director, LATAM

Location: Brazil or Mexico — supporting the LATAM region

Work Arrangement: Hybrid / Remote (home-office based, customer-facing)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Travel Required: Up to (40–50)% across the LATAM territory


Role Objective

Maximize Quectel’s LATAM market share and revenue for antenna products by developing new customers and verticals, accelerating antenna design wins, and enabling Regional Sales Managers to expand antenna penetration within the existing customer base.


Primary Responsibilities

Market Growth & New Business

  • Own LATAM growth for Quectel antenna products and solutions, with a strong focus on new customer acquisition, new verticals, and share expansion.
  • Build and actively hunt a prioritized funnel of target accounts with clear next actions, opportunity value, and design-win potential.
  • Identify cross-sell opportunities within the existing Quectel customer base and partner with RSMs to position antennas alongside modules and connectivity solutions.
  • Develop account strategies for OEMs, ODMs, and EMS providers whose products require cellular, GNSS, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth, or combination antennas.

Customer & Design-Win Development

  • Understand customer applications, RF/connectivity requirements, and program timing, and coordinate the right antenna solution.
  • Track antenna evaluations, samples, technical discussions, qualifications, and design-in/design-win progress through the regional funnel.
  • Initiate and schedule customer roadmap meetings to identify future programs and influence antenna selection early in the design cycle.
  • Maintain strong follow-up with prospects and customers from initial opportunity through technical evaluation and commercial conversion.

Sales Enablement & Channel Development

  • Train Regional Sales Managers, representative firms, and distributors on Quectel antenna positioning, target applications, and sales messages.
  • Create account-specific selling strategies and support local teams in advancing antenna opportunities.
  • Provide competitive and market insights that help the wider sales organization win antenna business.

Product & Internal Collaboration

  • Work closely with Product Management and technical teams on customer requirements, product fit, competitive gaps, and future roadmap needs.
  • Translate market feedback into actionable input for product planning and commercial strategy.
  • Coordinate internal resources to move strategic opportunities through evaluation and decision stages.

CRM, Reporting & Market Intelligence

  • Maintain accurate and current account, opportunity, and activity information in Salesforce CRM.
  • Prepare a monthly LATAM business review covering pipeline, leads, technical evaluations, meetings, risks, and next steps.
  • Monitor market trends, competitors, target verticals, and major customer programs relevant to antenna growth in LATAM.
  • Attend trade shows and industry events to identify target accounts and capture qualified contacts for follow-up.


Qualifications & Experience

What we are looking for

  • (5)+ years of demonstrated success in B2B technical sales, business development, or segment sales within antennas, RF components, wireless connectivity, IoT hardware, or a closely related field.
  • Strong ability to prospect, build pipeline, develop new accounts, and drive opportunities toward design wins and revenue.
  • Working understanding of customer design cycles and what it takes to win embedded hardware business.
  • Comfort discussing antenna use cases across cellular, GNSS, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth, and connected-device applications.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills across a multi-country sales region.
  • Hands-on CRM discipline and clear funnel and business-review reporting.
  • Fluent Portuguese and/or Spanish, plus professional working English.
  • Willingness to travel across LATAM for customer meetings, partner development, and industry events.

Preferred background

  • Experience selling antennas, RF solutions, IoT modules, or related components to OEM/ODM/EMS customers.
  • Existing relationships within LATAM IoT, industrial, telematics, or tracking ecosystems.
  • Experience supporting distributors, representative firms, or channel partners.
  • Ability to collaborate with Product Management, FAE, and engineering teams on technical evaluations.
  • Familiarity with certification and homologation processes in LATAM markets (e.g., ANATEL, IFT).

What Success Looks Like

  • Growth in qualified antenna pipeline and new target accounts.
  • Increase in antenna design-ins/design wins and commercial conversions.
  • Higher antenna penetration across existing Quectel accounts.
  • Strong RSM/channel enablement and opportunity follow-through.
  • Accurate Salesforce funnel management and monthly reporting.
  • Actionable market/competitive intelligence that improves sales execution.


About Quectel

Quectel’s passion for a smarter world drives us to accelerate IoT innovation. We are an end-to-end global IoT solutions provider, and our team of more than 5,800 professionals delivers cellular, GNSS, satellite, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth modules, high-performance antennas, and full turnkey offerings including ODM services and system integration.

Founded in 2010 and headquartered in Shanghai, Quectel operates offices, R&D centers, and support teams across APAC, EMEA, North America, and LATAM. Our antenna business combines a broad standard portfolio with full custom design support — simulation, testing, tuning, and manufacturing.


Industries & Applications

Quectel’s modules and antennas power innovation across:

  • Smart metering and utilities
  • Asset tracking, telematics, and logistics
  • Smart agriculture
  • Smart cities and infrastructure
  • Industrial IoT and automation
  • Connected mobility and automotive
  • Smart home and consumer IoT

Why Quectel LATAM?

  • Global Impact, Regional Focus — Own a product line across Latin America, backed by a global organization with teams in APAC, EMEA, and North America.
  • Career Growth — Mentorship, international exposure, internal mobility, and clear advancement paths.
  • Cutting-Edge Technology — Next-generation 5G, GNSS, NTN/satellite, and custom antenna solutions in mission-critical applications.
  • Inclusive, Global Team — A multicultural workplace collaborating with IoT experts across engineering, sales, and operations.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive base salary benchmarked to the local market in Brazil or Mexico
  • Uncapped sales commission tied to antenna revenue and design wins in your territory
  • Meal and grocery vouchers
  • Private health insurance with no co-pay, extendable to dependents
  • Dental coverage
  • Life insurance and accident cover
  • Paid time off plus statutory holidays, and paid parental leave per local law
  • International exposure — HQ visits and global trade shows such as CES, Embedded World, and MWC
  • Structured onboarding and ongoing product training, with internal mobility across a global organization


Learn More

Explore products, careers, and news at or follow Quectel Wireless Solutions on LinkedIn.

Note: Responsibilities may evolve based on business priorities and market needs.


Quectel is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic.

description:

  • Experience in digital media or marketing is a plus
  • Proficiency in English, spoken and written.

title: Video Editor
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle: from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

We are seeking a talented Video Editor to create high-performing video content for paid social advertising campaigns. You will edit engaging, conversion-focused video ads for Meta, TikTok, and Instagram Reels while working closely with our creative strategists and design team. This role requires fast turnaround capabilities, a keen understanding of performance creative principles, and the ability to manage multiple client projects simultaneously in a fully remote environment.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently high video output with exceptional quality and attention to detail
  • Strong creative performance metrics (CTR, watch time, engagement) across your video portfolio
  • Seamless collaboration with creative strategists, designers, and media buyers to iterate and optimize
  • Efficient project management and timely delivery across multiple concurrent client accounts


Responsibilities

  • Edit high-performing video ads for paid social campaigns across Meta, TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts
  • Execute on creative briefs and storyboards developed by creative strategists
  • Add motion graphics, text overlays, captions, and effects to enhance video storytelling and performance
  • Work with raw UGC footage and branded content to create attention-grabbing, under-15-second video ads
  • Iterate quickly on video concepts based on performance data and feedback from media buyers
  • Maintain brand consistency across multiple client accounts while adapting to different brand voices
  • Organize and manage video assets, project files, and creative libraries across all client accounts
  • Stay current on platform trends, best practices, and format specifications for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and Meta
  • Collaborate with creative strategists on video concepts and provide input on creative direction
  • Conduct research on competitor ads and trending content to inform video creative approaches
  • Pull and optimize stills from videos for ad thumbnails and static creative variations
  • Participate in weekly design team meetings and collaborate with designers and fellow video editors


Requirements

  • 2-4 years of video editing experience, preferably in performance marketing or advertising
  • Expert proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe After Effects
  • Motion graphics and animation capabilities
  • Portfolio demonstrating social-first video work for paid advertising (Meta, TikTok, Instagram Reels)
  • Strong understanding of performance creative principles and direct response video best practices
  • Proven ability to work in a fast-paced environment with tight deadlines and high volume output
  • Experience editing UGC (User Generated Content) and creator-style content
  • Excellent attention to detail with strong quality control standards
  • Fluent English communication skills for client collaboration and team coordination
  • DTC or ecommerce experience working with product-focused brands
  • Comfortable working remotely with distributed teams across multiple time zones


Nice to Have

  • Experience with CapCut or other mobile-first editing tools
  • Sound design and audio mixing skills
  • Understanding of TikTok and Instagram Reels trends and viral content strategies
  • Experience with color grading and advanced post-production techniques
  • Basic design skills in Figma or Adobe Creative Suite
  • Agency experience managing multiple concurrent client projects


Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience

title: Sr. Workday Financials Consultant
description:
Senior Workday Financials Consultant

About the Role

Aspire is looking for a Senior Workday Financials Consultant to join our Finance Solution Delivery team on a contract basis.

In this role, you will serve as a versatile Workday Financials subject matter expert , supporting production operations, system enhancements, and strategic Finance transformation initiatives.

You will work closely with Finance, Accounting, Procurement, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure the Workday Financials platform remains stable, scalable, and continuously optimized.

This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced Workday Financials professional who can work independently, solve complex problems, and provide hands-on expertise across multiple Financials domains.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide hands-on configuration, administration, and production support across Workday Financials.
  • Troubleshoot system issues, investigate defects, and provide timely and effective resolutions.
  • Partner with Finance, Accounting, Procurement, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into scalable Workday solutions.
  • Support multiple Financials domains and adapt to changing business priorities.
  • Design, configure, and optimize Workday solutions with a focus on scalability, maintainability, and long-term platform health.
  • Deliver system enhancements, optimizations, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Collaborate with technical and functional teams on reporting, integrations, and platform enhancements .
  • Support strategic Finance transformation initiatives and future Workday capabilities.
  • Maintain clear and accurate documentation for configurations, business processes, and solution designs.
  • Work effectively in a fast-paced and collaborative environment with stakeholders across U.S. time zones.

Required Qualifications

  • 8–10 years of hands-on Workday Financials experience.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end financial processes within Workday .
  • Proven experience supporting both production environments and project-based initiatives .
  • Ability to work independently and effectively in a fast-paced and sometimes ambiguous environment.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and systems-thinking skills.
  • Demonstrated expertise across multiple Workday Financials domains.

Priority Workday Financials Areas

Highest Priority

  • Financial Accounting
  • Expenses
  • Business Assets

Secondary Priority

  • Banking & Settlement

Nice to Have

  • VNDLY experience

Lower Priority

  • Procurement experience — the organization is gradually phasing this area out.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, success means you:

  • Seamlessly support multiple Workday Financials domains based on business priorities.
  • Reduce the production support backlog and improve responsiveness to Finance stakeholders.
  • Deliver scalable, maintainable solutions rather than short-term fixes.
  • Resolve issues efficiently while minimizing business disruption.
  • Become a trusted extension of the core Workday team.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement and long-term Finance transformation initiatives.

Why Aspire?

  • Join a Remote-First organization.
  • Work alongside exceptional technology professionals from around the world.
  • Access continuous technical and professional development opportunities.
  • Gain international exposure by collaborating with global technology leaders.
  • Receive nursery reimbursement benefits.
  • Participate in virtual and onsite international technology conferences.
  • Work within an IT environment aligned with rigorous security and compliance standards, including ISO and SOC frameworks .

title: Sr. Workday Financials Consultant
description:
Senior Workday Financials Consultant

About the Role

Aspire is looking for a Senior Workday Financials Consultant to join our Finance Solution Delivery team on a contract basis.

In this role, you will serve as a versatile Workday Financials subject matter expert , supporting production operations, system enhancements, and strategic Finance transformation initiatives.

You will work closely with Finance, Accounting, Procurement, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure the Workday Financials platform remains stable, scalable, and continuously optimized.

This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced Workday Financials professional who can work independently, solve complex problems, and provide hands-on expertise across multiple Financials domains.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide hands-on configuration, administration, and production support across Workday Financials.
  • Troubleshoot system issues, investigate defects, and provide timely and effective resolutions.
  • Partner with Finance, Accounting, Procurement, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into scalable Workday solutions.
  • Support multiple Financials domains and adapt to changing business priorities.
  • Design, configure, and optimize Workday solutions with a focus on scalability, maintainability, and long-term platform health.
  • Deliver system enhancements, optimizations, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Collaborate with technical and functional teams on reporting, integrations, and platform enhancements .
  • Support strategic Finance transformation initiatives and future Workday capabilities.
  • Maintain clear and accurate documentation for configurations, business processes, and solution designs.
  • Work effectively in a fast-paced and collaborative environment with stakeholders across U.S. time zones.

Required Qualifications

  • 8–10 years of hands-on Workday Financials experience.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end financial processes within Workday .
  • Proven experience supporting both production environments and project-based initiatives .
  • Ability to work independently and effectively in a fast-paced and sometimes ambiguous environment.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and systems-thinking skills.
  • Demonstrated expertise across multiple Workday Financials domains.

Priority Workday Financials Areas

Highest Priority

  • Financial Accounting
  • Expenses
  • Business Assets

Secondary Priority

  • Banking & Settlement

Nice to Have

  • VNDLY experience

Lower Priority

In this role, success means you:

  • Seamlessly support multiple Workday Financials domains based on business priorities.
  • Reduce the production support backlog and improve responsiveness to Finance stakeholders.
  • Deliver scalable, maintainable solutions rather than short-term fixes.
  • Resolve issues efficiently while minimizing business disruption.
  • Become a trusted extension of the core Workday team.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement and long-term Finance transformation initiatives.

title: Junior Recruiter (Remote)
description:
The Junior Recruiter supports the Talent Acquisition function by identifying, engaging, and assessing early-career and emerging talent. This role provides foundational support in sourcing, candidate management, and market research, enabling the organization to build high-quality talent pipelines and enhance hiring outcomes. The Junior Recruiter operates with curiosity, discipline, and a growth mindset, contributing to a proactive and insight-led approach to recruitment.


Global Market Mapping & Talent Intelligence

  • Support the creation and maintenance of basic talent maps across priority roles and regions.
  • Conduct preliminary research into competitor and industry talent pools.
  • Monitor emerging skills and support insights that inform Talent Partners.
  • Assist in translating basic market findings into structured summaries and recommendations.


Proactive Sourcing & Candidate Identification

  • Assist in sourcing passive candidates for early-career and specialist roles using multiple channels.
  • Screen profiles to assess alignment with role requirements.
  • Engage talent through professional, timely communication to build candidate interest.
  • Maintain organized, high-quality talent pipelines within recruitment systems.


Partnership with Talent Partners

  • Support Talent Partners with research, shortlists, and candidate outreach.
  • Contribute to search strategies with relevant market findings.
  • Help prepare candidate summaries, insights, and support documents.
  • Collaborate closely to ensure alignment with hiring priorities and talent plans.


Candidate Experience & Process Excellence

  • Ensure candidates receive timely, clear, and professional communication throughout the process.
  • Coordinate interviews, assessments, and feedback loops.
  • Uphold high standards of confidentiality and professionalism.
  • Support improvements to recruitment processes, tools, and efficiency.


Employer Brand & External Presence

  • Represent the organization positively when interacting with external talent.
  • Share the employer value proposition clearly and consistently.
  • Contribute to targeted outreach campaigns and engagement initiatives.


Tools, Technology & Data Discipline

  • Maintain accurate candidate and pipeline data within recruiting tools.
  • Use sourcing platforms and talent intelligence tools with increasing proficiency.
  • Support basic reporting and pipeline updates for Talent Partners.


Candidate Profile

Experience & Capability

  • Previous experience in recruitment, sourcing, HR, or related areas.
  • Previous experience in recruitment for US companies or Global market - desirable
  • Previous experience in recruitment in LATAM region - desirable
  • Exposure to research, sourcing, or candidate engagement preferred.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks with strong attention to detail.


Technical Strength

  • Proficiency with LinkedIn Recruiter or similar sourcing tools.
  • Strong organizational and data-management skills.
  • Advanced English required.
  • Spanish - intermediate


Mindset & Behaviours

  • Curious, proactive, and eager to learn about talent markets and recruitment best practices.
  • Resilient and comfortable working in fast-paced environments.
  • Professional communicator who can build rapport with candidates and stakeholders.
  • Team-oriented with a growth mindset.


Working Scheme: remote

Contract: Full time - Indefinite period.
