title: Business Analyst Trainee — Marketing Automation & AI
description:
Type: 90‑day, full‑time remote internship/trainee program (paid)

Pay: USD $1,000 / month

Contract: Independent contractor (Canada‑based company)

Future: Outstanding interns may receive a full‑time offer.

Non-negotiable requirement: Advanced English


Ready to Apply? We value thoughtful applications over quick submissions. Please send short introduction video to j. Include any relevant experience or examples of your work that demonstrate your skills in building things.


Alternatively, you will receive an automated email to prepare a one-way video interview as the first step of the hiring process.


What You’ll Do

  • Build from zero: Stand up internal marketing‑agency systems, analytics stacks, and repeatable processes—often with no existing playbook.
  • Automate & optimize: Map workflows, identify bottlenecks, and deploy no‑code/low‑code, AI, or integration tools (Cursor, Replit, Zapier, Make, GPT, etc.) to streamline them.
  • Turn data into insight: Design dashboards and translate numbers into actionable narratives for stakeholders.
  • Ship & educate: Draft launch content, craft go‑to‑market strategies, and create user‑friendly training to ensure adoption.


You’ll Thrive Here If You…

  • Learn fast: You welcome constructive pushback and treat every project as a chance to sharpen your craft.
  • Love variety: Each day’s challenges differ—expect context switching and rapid iteration.
  • Communicate crisply: Advanced written and spoken English is non‑negotiable.
  • Stay curious: New tech doesn’t scare you; you experiment until it bends to the problem.


Core Skills…

  • Professional/Bilingual proficiency in English. All business activities require an advanced level of English
  • Business writing & stakeholder persuasion
  • Familiarity with no‑code / AI automation platforms
  • Data literacy & visualization sense
  • Project management fundamentals

description:

Location : Brazil (Remote)

Job Summary

We are seeking a Senior Program Manager, PMO to lead cross-functional programs across product development, market research, data, quality, vendor management, training, change management, and launch readiness. • Ability to bring structure and accountability in evolving project environments.

• Portuguese proficiency.

• Experience in primary market research, commercial insights, AI, or data programs.

• PMP or CSPO certification.

title: Supervisor de Vendas - Canal Indireto - Experiência com sorvetes/alimentos congelados e refrigerados – Campo Grande - MS
description:
Buscamos profissional com experiência com Vendas de produtos alimentar (congelados/refrigerados) no Canal Indireto . Experiência em lidar com time de vendas de Distribuidores.


Local de trabalho: Campo Grande - MS


Resumo da vaga:

Responsável por liderar a equipe comercial do distribuidor. Irá atuar diretamente na execução e no acompanhamento das metas de vendas. Garantir a presença dos produtos nos pontos de venda, execução perfeita, assegurar o cumprimento dos objetivos comerciais e apoiar o crescimento sustentável da operação.


Atribuições:

  • Supervisionar a equipe de vendas externas, promotores e representantes do distribuidor
  • Garantir a execução do plano de vendas, com foco em volume, positivação e distribuição dos sorvetes nos clientes ativos e potenciais.
  • Monitorar diariamente os indicadores de desempenho (sell-in, sell-out, cobertura, ticket médio, giro de produto).
  • Visitar clientes estratégicos e apoiar o time em negociações e ativações de mercado.
  • Acompanhar a roteirização, frequência de visitas e cobertura de área da equipe.
  • Desenvolver estratégias promocionais e ações de mercado em parceria com o setor de marketing e trade.
  • Treinar, motivar e desenvolver o time comercial.
  • Assegurar o correto uso de materiais de merchandising, freezers e visibilidade dos produtos nos PDVs.
  • Garantir execução perfeita


Requisitos:

Formação - Nível Superior Completo


Experiência Profissional - Experiência comprovada em liderança de equipes de vendas do Distribuidor, preferencialmente no setor de alimentos, bebidas, sorvetes.


Diferenciais: Experiência com distribuição de produtos congelados e refrigerados preferencialmente com sorvetes.

description:
Job Description: Senior Corporate Account Manager


Company Overview:

bTd Travel & Jets is a leading global concierge travel company with a presence in the US, Brazil, and Portugal and expanding to Spain and Mexico in 2025 and across Europe, Latin America, and GCC later. bTd operates under three innovative models: B2C  (exclusive membership services), B2B  (corporate travel management), and B2B2C  (travel concierge services for business partners). Within the B2B model, we specialize in delivering cutting-edge corporate travel management solutions through our bTd Corp Tool .

This platform seamlessly blends intuitive technology with personalized services, simplifying business travel with exclusive rates on commercial flights, hotels, car services worldwide, with automated processes, and a focus on exceptional customer satisfaction. Beyond corporate travel, we also provide employees with access to bTd travel benefits  and personalized concierge services for their leisure trips, enriching their overall travel experiences.


CX Travel Specialist (2 positions: Either Early Morning Shift - From 4 AM to 13 PM Brazil time or From 4 PM to 1 AM Brazil time)

We are looking for two (2) CX Travel Specialist  to join our Customer Experience (CX) team. The ideal candidates are experienced with Amadeus and corporate travel management to support our global clients during night shifts.


Main Responsibilities

• Manage bookings for flights, hotels, and car rentals via Amadeus and other tools.

• Handle client requests, changes, and special services via WhatsApp and email.

• Process exchanges, refunds, EMDs, and monitor itineraries proactively.

• Support VIP and C-level travelers with high-touch, discreet service.

• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure accuracy and client satisfaction.


Requirements

• Experience in luxury or corporate travel.

• Strong experience with Amadeus GDS (Air module) - Advanced level

(An Amadeus Test will be conducted to verify level of proficiency before any job offer is sent)

• Background in TMCs, agencies, or airlines.

• Proficiency in English and Portuguese. Spanish is a plus.

• Tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and flexible for night/weekend shifts.

  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills across multiple languages.
  • Intermediate knowledge in NDC platforms is required.
  • Effective training and delegation skills, with a \"learning by doing\" approach.
  • Ability to navigate diverse geographic markets and cultural contexts effectively.

• Knowledge of ARC (USA) and or IATA BSP accounting process is a plus


Why Join Us

• Work in a dynamic, global environment focused on service excellence.

• Engage with high-profile clients and premium travel partners.

• Be part of a collaborative, growth-oriented culture.

• Enjoy a remote-first setup with flexible work arrangements


bTd Travel Culture:

At bTd, we are passionate about travel, bridging distances, connecting worlds, and creating unique experiences for our clients. We foster a culture that embodies entrepreneurship, hands-on collaboration, and teamwork. Our flexible work environment supports work-life balance, eliminating commuting time and offering opportunities for relocation or nomadic work. We are driven by a global mindset, a passion for client success, and a strong focus on results. Our environment values risk-taking, leadership development, and learning by doing, providing multiple opportunities for personal and professional growth. We respect diversity at all levels and embrace meritocracy, rewarding high performance and ensuring no space for toxic behavior or poor performance.

bTd is committed to corporate governance, ethics, and mutual trust, building confidence through facts and evidence rather than perceptions. We promote an open, friendly, and respectful atmosphere where differences and preferences are honored. Join us and grow alongside bTd, with the opportunity to become part of the company’s evolution and stakes.


Terms of Employment:

  • Employment under CLT (Brazilian Labor Laws) .
  • Remote work arrangement, with a 44-hour workweek
  • Flexibility to travel domestically within Brazil and internationally to locations where bTd operates.
  • This position is required or night shift and weekends, with flexibility.
  • Excels in remote work for a global hybrid startup, combining tech-driven travel solutions with personalized services.


Compensation:

  • Competitive base salary.
  • Night shift extra hours
  • Performance-based bonuses and monthly premiums based on achieving KPIs.
  • Sales commissions for achieving and exceeding targets.
  • Health and dental insurance.
  • Food card.
  • Birthday day off.
  • Opportunity for professional growth, with the potential to be promoted to Head of Corporate Globally  as bTd evolves through its funding rounds.
  • Access to travel-related perks and benefits as part of the bTd team.


Important Note Before Applying:

Let’s keep it real! Apply only if you meet at least 80% of the qualifications  and can prove it with your LinkedIn profile or updated resume . We’re not looking for someone who just \"gets it\" — we need a self-starter  ready to deliver results from day one .

Forget gaming LinkedIn algorithms; we care about real achievements. If your experience matches the role and your profile shows your impact, we’re excited to hear from you, hire you fast, reward your contributions, and grow together.

Note:  Only candidates meeting the criteria will be contacted for an interview. Let’s keep it efficient and worthwhile for everyone! 🚀

title: Remote M&A Lawyer - Brazil
description:
About Moritz


Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.


We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.


We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.


Moritz has raised a $9M seed round from Y Combinator, 20VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.


The Role


  • Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's M&A work in Brazil: share and asset deals, mergers, carve-outs, and joint ventures for clients ranging from startups to midsize companies.
  • Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of SPAs and APAs, disclosure schedules, warranties and indemnities, and ancillary transaction documents.
  • Run legal due diligence, coordinate specialist workstreams (tax, employment, IP, regulatory), and manage the transaction timeline through signing and closing.
  • Advise on deal structuring, earn-outs and deferred consideration, W&I insurance, closing mechanics, and post-closing matters.
  • If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.


What You'll Bring


  • 5+ years practising M&A or corporate law in private practice or in-house.
  • End-to-end deal experience. You've led transactions from term sheet through closing, not just supported workstreams.
  • Deep familiarity with transaction documents — SPAs, APAs, disclosure letters, warranty and indemnity regimes, and completion mechanics.
  • Due diligence command. You can scope, run, and synthesize a diligence exercise into findings a buyer can act on.
  • Cross-border fluency. Comfortable coordinating with counsel in other jurisdictions on multi-country deals.
  • Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.


Why Moritz


  • Run deals with modern tooling — faster diligence, cleaner documents, and clients who value speed and certainty.
  • Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice.
  • Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity.
  • Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.


Frequently Asked Questions


How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?


Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.


What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?


Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.


Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?


No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.


How are co-counsel matched to client matters?


Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

title: Account Manager
description:
We're Convert Sail, an e-commerce conversion optimization agency. We work with Shopify brands spending $100K-$1M+/month on ads, and we move fast. Really fast.


We're looking for an Account Manager to own client relationships and project delivery. You'll manage 8-10 client accounts, coordinate landing page and funnel builds with our design and dev team, and be the main point of contact when clients need something.


This isn't a 9-5 role where you clock out and forget about work. When a client has a launch on Saturday, you're online. When a project is behind, you stay late to fix it. We ship fast, we work weekends when it matters, and most people flame out in the first 90 days because they can't handle the pace.


If that scares you, this isn't the role for you.


If that excites you, keep reading.


What you'll do:


  • Own 8-10 client relationships and make sure they're happy, on track, and renewing long-term
  • Manage day-to-day client communication and set clear expectations
  • Coordinate landing page and funnel projects with our design and dev team—keep timelines tight and make sure nothing slips
  • Proactively identify and solve client issues before they become fires
  • Track project progress in ClickUp and ensure deadlines are met
  • Help clients see ROI from our work so they stick around for 6-12+ months, not 2-3
  • Be available during USA business hours and occasionally on weekends when client launches require it


What we're looking for:


  • 2+ years of experience managing client accounts in a fast-paced agency, SaaS company, or startup
  • Fluent English speaker with strong written and verbal communication skills
  • You've worked in high-pressure environments before and didn't crack under the weight
  • You're organized, proactive, and don't need someone checking in on you every 2 hours
  • You don't let things fall through the cracks—you follow up, you track details, you close loops
  • Experience with project management tools like ClickUp, Asana, or similar
  • Comfortable working remotely, but you don't treat \"remote\" like \"invisible\"
  • Bonus: Experience with e-commerce, Shopify, or conversion optimization (not required, but helpful)


What we offer:


  • Compensation: $12/hour ($2,000+/month full-time) + performance bonuses (depending on experience)
  • Fully remote—work from anywhere as long as you're available US hours
  • Work with real scaling brands, not broke startups or tire-kickers
  • Small team, so you'll have real impact and visibility
  • You'll learn more in 6 months here than 2 years at a slow-moving corporate job
  • Opportunity to grow into a senior role as the agency scales


How to apply:


Don't send a resume first.


Record a 4-minute Loom video (free tool, Google it if you don't know it) and tell us:


  • Why you want this job
  • Why we should hire you
  • A time you had to manage a difficult client situation and how you handled it


Then email the Loom link to:


Subject line must include the word BUILDER. If it doesn't, we'll assume you can't follow instructions and we won't read your application.


If you can't handle recording a 4-minute video, you definitely can't handle this role.

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role

At Revolut, Operations means problem-solving at scale. Our team tackles the company’s toughest challenges with speed, precision, and creativity. They design systems that unlock efficiency and power global growth.

We're looking for a Strategy & Operations Manager to help shape how we continue to expand and operate across the globe. You’ll work on high-impact initiatives throughout the business, using insight to solve challenges, scale processes, and deliver better outcomes for our customers.

Watch this video from our team members about what goes into being a Strategy & Operations Manager at Revolut.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.


What you’ll be doing

  • Building and optimising scalable processes to continue Revolut's hyper-growth
  • Leading and executing core infrastructure projects
  • Exploring and defining which projects the team should prioritise, and setting a timeline to reach goals quickly
  • Searching for new features to provide a seamless customer experience
  • Managing critical vendor relationships and building performance tracking systems
  • Developing strategic supply chain partnerships and negotiating commercial terms


What you'll need

  • At least a 2:1 degree from a top university
  • 4+ years of work experience in a fast-paced environment
  • A solid track record of taking ownership and leading complex projects end to end
  • A magic skill to break complex problems into smaller ones
  • To enjoy working with data
  • Natural curiosity and a will to make an impact
  • An interest in the financial industry


Nice to have

  • Experience coding with SQL, Python, or R



Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

title: Remote Real Estate Lawyer - Brazil
description:
About Moritz


Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.


We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.


We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.


Moritz has raised a $9M seed round from Y Combinator, 20VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.


The Role


  • Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's real estate work in Brazil: commercial leases, sale and purchase agreements, real estate aspects of corporate transactions, and development and construction agreements.
  • Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of leases and property transaction documents for clients ranging from startups taking their first office to enterprises managing property portfolios.
  • Run title review and property due diligence, including for real estate elements of M&A and financing transactions.
  • Advise on real estate financing and security, planning and zoning questions, and landlord-tenant matters.
  • If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.


What You'll Bring


  • 5+ years practising commercial real estate law in private practice or in-house.
  • Leasing depth. Office, retail, industrial, and flexible-space leases — rent review, service charges, repair obligations, break options, and assignments.
  • Transactional experience. Sale and purchase agreements, title review and due diligence, conditions, and completion mechanics.
  • Financing familiarity. Mortgages, security packages, and the real estate workstreams of corporate deals.
  • Practical judgment. You separate the points that protect the client from the points that stall the deal.
  • Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.


Why Moritz


  • Bring speed and clarity to real estate transactions traditionally slowed by process.
  • Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice.
  • Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity.
  • Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.


Frequently Asked Questions


How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?


Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.


What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?


Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.


Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?


No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.


How are co-counsel matched to client matters?


Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

title: Senior DTC Video Editor
description:
We are a leading brand in health supplements for women over 40. Our mission is to improve the quality of life for women going through menopause by solving real, everyday challenges—weight gain, hot flashes, insomnia, mood shifts, and more.


We’re looking for a Senior DTC Video Editor to join our team full-time and help us create high-performing Meta video ads for our e-commerce brand.


What you’ll do:

  • Edit performance-driven DTC/Meta ads
  • Lead, train, and support a team of video editors
  • Review editors’ work and provide feedback
  • Help improve our editing processes and creative output
  • Have a calls with your team + video editing team


Requirements:

  • Strong experience editing DTC / Meta ads
  • Previous experience leading or training video editors
  • Strong understanding of direct-response creative
  • Excellent attention to detail and creative judgment
  • Full-time availability: 6 AM–2 PM EST
  • Experience with wellness or supplement brands is a big plus


IMPORTANT:

  • You must provide a portfolio showing Meta ads you personally edited.
  • Location: South America, Europe


Please also include:

  • Number of editors you’ve led/trained
  • DTC/e-commerce brands you’ve worked with
  • Your Meta ad editing experience Applications without relevant Meta ad examples will not be considered.


Resume must be in English.

title: Supervisor(a) de Relacionamento com o Cliente
description:
Olá, somos a SuperFrete :)


Queremos ser a maior e mais amada rede de logística digital, quer fazer parte disso?


Somos uma startup que atua no segmento do varejo e logística, apoiando os pequenos e médios empreendedores a se tornarem mais competitivos no mercado e a alavancarem suas vendas. Por isso, buscamos um Super Supervisor(a) de Relacionamento com o Cliente , que se identifique com o nosso propósito, que tenha muita energia para somar no time de Operações e que queira crescer (muito!) com a gente.


Responsabilidades

  • Liderar, acompanhar e desenvolver o time de Relacionamento com o Cliente (Customer Service), promovendo engajamento e alta performance;
  • Acompanhar os principais indicadores da operação, como CSAT, TMPR e TMT, identificando desvios e conduzindo planos de ação;
  • Gerenciar a produtividade e a capacidade operacional, garantindo eficiência e fluidez no atendimento;
  • Monitorar o desempenho da IA de atendimento e dos fluxos da plataforma, identificando oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Realizar alinhamentos, 1:1 e feedbacks, apoiando o desenvolvimento das pessoas e a evolução do time;
  • Atuar na priorização de demandas e na resolução de problemas junto a outras áreas;
  • Conduzir processos seletivos e apoiar o onboarding e a integração de novas pessoas;
  • Analisar dados e apresentar os resultados da operação, consolidando indicadores e planos de ação para os acompanhamentos semanais e mensais.


Requisitos

  • Experiência em operações de atendimento ao cliente nos canais de chat e e-mail;
  • Experiência com liderança de equipes compostas majoritariamente por profissionais juniores e estagiários;
  • Experiência no acompanhamento de indicadores operacionais e gestão de performance;
  • Forte capacidade analítica e habilidade para utilizar dados na tomada de decisão;
  • Experiência com gestão de produtividade, capacidade operacional e rotinas de atendimento;
  • Vivência em gestão de pessoas, incluindo 1:1, feedbacks, desenvolvimento e acompanhamento de performance;
  • Experiência na contratação, integração e desenvolvimento de novos colaboradores;
  • Familiaridade com plataformas de atendimento e ferramentas de gestão operacional;
  • Conhecimento intermediário em Google Sheets ou Excel para acompanhamento e análise de indicadores;
  • Experiência com dashboards e acompanhamento de KPIs;
  • Perfil orientado à melhoria contínua, resolução de problemas e eficiência operacional.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em startups, empresas de tecnologia, marketplaces ou empresas de logística;
  • Experiência com Customer Experience (CX) e indicadores de satisfação, como CSAT e NPS;
  • Experiência com operações que utilizam IA e automação no atendimento;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de Business Intelligence, como Looker Studio ou Power BI;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de IA Generativa aplicadas à produtividade, análise de dados e operações;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de atendimento e gestão de tickets, como HubSpot ou similares.


O que você pode esperar dos Supers?

  • Uma cultura de muita confiança, colaboração, focada em resultados, com muita autonomia e transparência;
  • Buscamos excelência em tudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo;
  • Temos vontade de construir junto, fazer a diferença e gerar impacto.


O que oferecemos:

  • 🧾Modelo de contratação: PJ;
  • Modelo de trabalho 100% remoto: uma oportunidade de crescimento acessível para talentos em todo o Brasil;
  • ⚕ Plano de Saúde: mantenha-se saudável com nosso abrangente plano de saúde nacional com consultas online e presenciais;
  • ♀️GymPass/Wellhub: bem-estar completo para você cuidar da sua saúde física e mental com os aplicativos integrados;
  • Voucher Kit Escritório: receba um voucher para turbinar o seu espaço de trabalho e garantir seu conforto, comodidade e produtividade;
  • Férias remuneradas: desfrute de 30 dias de férias remuneradas por ano para recarregar suas energias e relaxar;
  • Programa Super-Get-Super: indique um talento e receba um bônus;
  • 😊Cultura colaborativa: nossa cultura é baseada na confiança, parceria e foco em resultados. Oferecemos um ambiente com autonomia e transparência;
  • Incentivo ao desenvolvimento: estamos comprometidos com a excelência e o aprendizado contínuo. Oferecemos avaliações semestrais, conversas de one-on-one, feedbacks construtivos, e muito mais;
  • Programa de Stock Option: possibilidade de se tornar sócio da empresa e participar diretamente do nosso crescimento. Somos reconhecidos como uma das startups mais promissoras do Brasil pela lista 100 Startups to Watch.



E aí, vamos juntos nesse SuperFoguete? 🚀

title: FinCrime Analyst (Investigations) - Brazil
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.


As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people.


People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.



About the role

Financial Crime Operations is at the forefront of Revolut’s efforts to keep customers and their money safe. Team members work directly with customers to resolve issues and flag potential concerns. Using cutting-edge technology and sharp attention to detail, they help prevent financial crime and keep trust at the core of Revolut.


We’re looking for a Financial Crime Analyst to identify suspicious activity and ensure we’re treating customers fairly. You’ll be investigating internal SARs and complex cases by applying judgement, analytical skills, and solid decision-making to identify where grounds for suspicion of money laundering exist.


To support our 24/7 coverage, this role may include night and weekend shifts, which are fully compensated.


Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.



What you'll be doing

  • Reviewing, investigating, and reporting financial crime cases
  • Providing ongoing monitoring and resolving formal complaints and Financial Ombudsman Service complaints
  • Dealing appropriately with consent refusals following SAR submissions
  • Acting as a point of contact for law enforcement agencies in ongoing criminal investigations that commenced from a submitted SAR
  • Acting in accordance with written policies, procedures, and relevant legislation
  • Cooperating with other teams by providing professional and efficient front-line compliance support, seeking to improve company processes



What you'll need

  • A bachelor's degree (must be able to provide a certificate)
  • 3+ years in financial crime investigations, or 1+ years of SAR reporting experience
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese (C1+ level)
  • Experience working in a regulated or policy-driven environment (e.g., financial institutions, law enforcement)
  • Experience with investigative methodologies, evidenced by the use of analytical tools (e.g., spreadsheets, filters, pivots, network charts)
  • The ability to work with multiple stakeholders and take ownership of assigned workload
  • Adaptability and experience with fast-cycle feedback
  • To be able to work a variety of shifts, including nights and weekends



Nice to have

  • Fluency in other languages
  • A degree in law or a STEM subject
  • A professional certification (e.g., ICA or ACAMS)
  • Familiarity with jurisdiction-specific financial regulations
  • Experience in crypto or blockchain analysis



Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday.


We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.


Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Senior AWS Cloud Infrastructure & Linux Engineer | Inglês Avançado
description:
Senior AWS Cloud Infrastructure & Linux Engineer

Buscamos talento Senior AWS Cloud Infrastructure & Linux Engineer para atuar em um projeto estratégico de transformação e modernização de ambientes cloud corporativos. A posição exige forte experiência em AWS, Linux, automação de infraestrutura e operações em ambientes críticos de missão.


✅ CLT - 11h às 20h

✅ Atuação 100% remota

✅ Projeto com duração inicial de 1 ano, com possibilidade de extensão

✅ Inglês avançado/fluente mandatório


Requisitos

  • Sólida experiência com arquitetura e operações em ambientes AWS
  • Administração avançada de Linux (RHEL, Oracle Linux e Ubuntu)
  • Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform e/ou CloudFormation)
  • Automação com Shell Script e Python
  • Docker e Kubernetes (EKS é diferencial)
  • CI/CD e práticas DevOps
  • AWS IAM, segurança, governança e observabilidade
  • Experiência em troubleshooting, otimização de performance e suporte a ambientes críticos de produção.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com ambientes SAP hospedados na AWS
  • SAP S/4HANA e SAP HANA
  • AWS Launch Wizard para SAP
  • Arquiteturas de Alta Disponibilidade (HA) e Disaster Recovery (DR).

Se você gosta de desafios envolvendo Cloud Infrastructure, Linux, Automação e DevOps em escala corporativa , essa pode ser uma excelente oportunidade para dar o próximo passo na sua carreira.

title: Business Development & Marketing
description:
About iQIYI

iQIYI International is a global digital entertainment platform focused on Asian dramas, films, animation, variety shows and other content for international audiences. In Brazil and Latin America, we are building partnerships with leading media, telecom, digital platforms and brands to make Asian entertainment more accessible to local audiences.


Role purpose

Support iQIYI’s expansion in Brazil and Latin America by prospecting, developing and coordinating commercial and marketing partnerships. The role requires the ability to independently organize priorities, lead meetings, prepare proposals, follow up on opportunities and coordinate projects with external partners and internal teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia, without constant supervision.


Key responsibilities

1. Business Development & Partnerships – approximately 70%

  • Map, prospect and develop relationships with private and public free-to-air broadcasters, telecommunications operators, digital and OTT platforms, distributors, technology companies, payment providers, retailers, consumer brands and other strategic partners.
  • Build and maintain an organized pipeline of potential partners in Brazil and other Latin American markets, documenting contacts, opportunity stages, next steps, risks and timelines.
  • Prepare presentations, commercial proposals, preliminary partnership models, meeting minutes, progress reports and decision-support materials.
  • Lead initial meetings, identify partner needs and develop value propositions suited to different cooperation models.
  • Support negotiations involving content distribution, licensing, revenue sharing, subscription bundles, media/barter, co-marketing, customer benefits, promotions and other commercial models.
  • Negotiate commercial terms within approved parameters and coordinate validation with the Country Manager and relevant iQIYI functions; final approvals and signatures remain with management and headquarters.
  • Coordinate the progress of opportunities with internal content, marketing, product, technology, legal, finance, operations and other teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia.
  • Support partnership implementation after approval, ensuring alignment on scope, deliverables, timelines and performance indicators.
  • Conduct research on markets, competitors, potential partners and trends across streaming, television, telecommunications and entertainment in Latin America.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Junte-se à nossa equipe como professor de inglês remoto!

Na Flyover Idiomas, nosso diferencial está no processo de junção de alunos e professores, que visa aproveitar suas semelhanças, incluindo experiência e personalidade.

Estamos à procura de pessoas dedicadas e entusiasmadas para se juntarem à nossa equipe como professores de inglês remoto. Esta posição oferece a conveniência de trabalhar de qualquer lugar com horários flexíveis.


Sobre nós:  Somos uma escola de idiomas online comprometida em oferecer ensino de inglês de alta qualidade para alunos de todas as idades e contextos. Nossa missão é ensinar os alunos através de experiências de aprendizagem personalizadas, utilizando a abordagem comunicativa, com foco na fluência mais do que na precisão, selecionando materiais autênticos e relevantes, e integrando todas as quatro habilidades.


Visão geral da posição

  • Lecionar aulas de inglês, principalmente particulares ou em pequenos grupos.
  • Desenvolver planos de aula e atividades envolventes que atendam a diferentes necessidades de aprendizagem e níveis de proficiência, usando a abordagem comunicativa, focada na autonomia do aluno e na personalização da aula.
  • Participar de treinamentos, reuniões com nossos coordenadores e projetos diversos.
  • Fornecer feedback construtivo e ajudar os alunos a melhorar suas habilidades linguísticas.
  • Enviar relatórios das aulas para manter seus alunos e a escola atualizados sobre o andamento das mesmas.
  • Promover um ambiente de aprendizagem confortável e encorajador com foco no sucesso do alu no.


Formato

  • Contratação: Contrato com Microempreendedor Individual (MEI)
  • Local : Remoto
  • Carga Horária: Você define a sua própria agenda


Requisitos

  • Proficiência em inglês (mínimo C1)
  • Bacharel em Inglês, Educação, Linguística ou áreas similares (certificação TESOL/TEFL é um diferencial).
  • Experiência comprovada no ensino de inglês como segunda língua, seja online ou em sala de aula.
  • Disponibilidade de pelo menos 25 horas/semana, com alguns horários após as 17h (horário de São Paulo).
  • Habilidades de comunicação e de relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Conexão de internet estável, computador, webcam, espaço de trabalho privado e silencioso.
  • Familiaridade com plataformas de ensino online.
  • CNPJ / MEI ativo.


Por que se juntar à nós?

  • Flexibilidade: Trabalhe de qualquer lugar com um horário flexível que se adapte ao seu estilo de vida.
  • Impacto: Fazer a diferença na vida dos alunos, ajudando-os a atingir seus objetivos de aprendizagem.
  • Crescimento Profissional: Acesso a oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional e treinamento contínuo para aprimorar suas habilidades de ensino.
  • Comunidade de Apoio: Junte-se a uma equipe de educadores que se dedicam ao sucesso dos alunos e à melhoria contínua.

title: AI Annotator
description:
About the Project

We are looking for native or near-native speakers to support an AI data annotation and translation project. The role involves reviewing, translating, and annotating content according to detailed guidelines to help improve the quality and accuracy of AI systems.


Project Details

  • Work Type: Freelance / Remote
  • Commitment: Approx. 20 hours per week
  • Duration: 2 Months
  • Languages (required): Portuguese, English
  • Project Area: AI Data Annotation & Translation
  • Assessments: 2 mandatory assessments
  • Schedule: Flexible, based on project needs and your availability


Key Responsibilities

  • Perform annotation and translation tasks
  • Review and classify content according to project-specific guidelines
  • Ensure annotations and translations are accurate, consistent, and contextually appropriate
  • Identify linguistic, grammatical, cultural, and contextual issues
  • Follow project instructions and quality standards carefully
  • Maintain consistency across large volumes of data
  • Complete assigned tasks within the required timelines
  • Participate in quality checks and incorporate feedback when required


Requirements

  • Strong proficiency in Portuguese (native or near-native level preferred)
  • Good working proficiency in English
  • Excellent understanding of language, grammar, syntax, and cultural context
  • Previous experience in translation, data annotation, content review, linguistic evaluation, or AI/ML data projects is preferred
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow detailed guidelines
  • Ability to work independently in a remote/freelance environment
  • Reliable internet connection and access to a computer/laptop

title: Busco sócio-investidor ou interessado na aquisição de uma tecnologia de inteligência política
description:
Busco sócio-investidor ou interessado na aquisição de uma tecnologia de inteligência política

Estou abrindo uma oportunidade para quem tenha interesse em entrar como sócio e aportar capital para acelerar um produto de tecnologia já desenvolvido , ou eventualmente tenha interesse na aquisição integral da tecnologia .

Sou Marcos, desenvolvedor e especialista em tecnologia e produtos digitais , e desenvolvi 100% de forma independente o Critério Político — da concepção ao desenvolvimento da plataforma.


O que é o Critério Político?

O Critério Político é uma plataforma de inteligência política baseada em dados públicos , que organiza e transforma informações dispersas do Legislativo em dados estruturados para análise.

A plataforma permite consultar e cruzar informações como:

  • parlamentares e seus perfis;
  • atuação parlamentar;
  • presença e faltas;
  • projetos apresentados e aprovados;
  • votações;
  • gastos e fornecedores;
  • rankings e comparativos;
  • histórico de atuação;
  • indicadores e outros dados relacionados à atividade legislativa.

A ideia é transformar dados públicos complexos e dispersos em inteligência acessível e utilizável .


O que estou buscando

Neste momento, procuro uma pessoa ou empresa que enxergue potencial comercial na tecnologia e queira participar da próxima etapa.

Existem caminhos comerciais que já identifiquei e que pretendo desenvolver , especialmente junto a:

• escritórios de advocacia;

• Relações Governamentais/Public Affairs;

• empresas e setores regulados;

• consultorias;

• instituições e organizações que precisam acompanhar o ambiente político e legislativo.

A proposta pode seguir dois caminhos:

1️⃣ Sociedade

Entrada de um sócio-investidor, com aporte de capital e participação na empresa, para acelerarmos comercialmente o produto, desenvolvermos novos módulos e explorarmos os mercados que já estão mapeados.

A divisão societária e o formato do investimento seriam discutidos de acordo com o perfil, aporte e contribuição de cada parte.

2️⃣ Aquisição

Caso exista interesse especificamente na tecnologia, também estou aberto a conversar sobre a aquisição de 100% do produto , incluindo código-fonte, tecnologia, estrutura desenvolvida e demais ativos relacionados ao projeto, mediante negociação.


Por que estou abrindo essa possibilidade?

Porque o produto já foi integralmente desenvolvido por mim e não estou procurando alguém para simplesmente financiar uma ideia.

Estou procurando alguém que veja valor no que já foi construído e queira transformar essa tecnologia em um negócio maior — seja participando da operação como sócio, seja adquirindo o ativo tecnológico.

Procuro capital + visão de negócio + capacidade de execução/comercialização .

E, caso alguém enxergue valor principalmente na tecnologia, estou igualmente aberto a conversar sobre uma aquisição.

Se houver interesse real em conhecer o produto, participar como sócio-investidor ou avaliar uma possível aquisição, me envie uma mensagem privada.

Posso apresentar a plataforma, explicar o que já foi desenvolvido, os caminhos comerciais que estou considerando e discutir os diferentes formatos possíveis.

Critério Político — tecnologia de inteligência política construída do zero, pronta para a próxima etapa.

Marcos

title: Analytics and Automation Specialist
description:
REMOTE ANALYTICS AND AUTOMATION SPECIALIST TO WORK WITH SYDNEY, AUSTRALIA AGENCY. 


About The Role


SOMO is a Sydney-based performance marketing and digital agency, with a small London presence, hiring a Digital Analytics & Automation Specialist to help deliver on a services agreement with a major client, spanning analytics administration, technical implementation, measurement strategy, and workflow automation. This is a hands-on role covering everyday system hygiene through to building automated processes that reduce manual reporting and operational overhead.


The role is structured around three core service pillars, plus a growing automation function.


Working Hours & Availability


This role reports into a Sydney-based team, so overlap with Sydney business hours is essential :


  • Core availability window (required): 9:00am–1:00pm Sydney time (AEST/AEDT), every working day
  • The remaining hours of your 8-hour day are flexible and can be worked to suit your own schedule/timezone
  • Given Brazil's timezone difference, this core window will typically fall in the evening to midnight for a Brazil-based hire, candidates should confirm this is workable for them before applying


Key Responsibilities


1. Admin Tasks (system hygiene & operational support)

Manage platform access (GA4, GTM, Looker Studio)

Update dashboard permissions

Set up and maintain scheduled reports/emails

Conduct system hygiene audits

Maintain progress tracking documentation

Acknowledge and resolve routine requests within same-day/1-business-day turnaround


2. Implementation Tasks (technical setup & troubleshooting)

Configure event tracking (form submissions, button clicks, etc.)

Build and maintain dashboards, with a strong emphasis on advanced Looker Studio usage and setup (GA4 also used)

Pull data from third-party platforms via APIs and manage API integrations

Perform ad hoc data extractions

Troubleshoot data discrepancies across platforms

Support integrations with other third-party systems as needed


3. Strategy Tasks (consultative & planning support)

Contribute to measurement framework design

Assist with attribution model development

Support privacy/compliance strategy work (e.g. cookie consent changes)

Help plan reporting infrastructure

Assist in journey mapping and insights workshops


4. AI Automation (new capability)

Design and build AI-powered automation flows to streamline reporting, data extraction, and routine admin tasks (e.g. using tools like Zapier, Make, n8n, or custom scripts)

Identify opportunities to automate repetitive workflows currently done manually across admin and implementation tasks

Build and maintain automations that pull from analytics platforms (GA4, GTM, Looker Studio) and push into reporting or notification systems

Document automation logic clearly so workflows are maintainable by others on the team


Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong hands-on experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager, and advanced Looker Studio usage and setup  
  • Experience with event tracking implementation and debugging data discrepancies
  • Comfort pulling data from third-party platforms via APIs , and general familiarity working with API endpoints
  • Understanding of measurement frameworks and attribution modelling
  • Working knowledge of privacy/compliance requirements affecting tracking (e.g. cookie consent)
  • Demonstrated experience building AI automation flows — e.g. Zapier, Make.com, n8n, or custom integrations using LLM/API-based tooling
  • Strong documentation habits
  • Ability to work independently on assigned tasks while flagging proactive recommendations
  • Excellent English (written and verbal) — essential
  • Comfortable communicating directly with clients , including handling complex briefs and translating technical detail into clear, client-ready language


Nice to Have

  • Experience managing Google Ads campaigns and reporting on channel performance
  • Prior agency-side experience managing enterprise client relationships
  • Exposure to Python or JavaScript for custom automation/scripting


Working Arrangements

  • Must be available Sydney 9:00am–1:00pm (AEST/AEDT) daily for overlap with the Sydney team; remaining hours of the 8-hour day are flexible.
  • Standard client-facing hours are Monday–Friday, 9:00am–1:00pm AEST, excluding public holidays, unless otherwise agreed.
  • Tasks are formally assigned with defined scope and timelines.
  • Deliverables must meet a professional standard and align with the task categories above.
  • Four weeks annual leave, sick leave + 9 days of public holidays. These can be used for your local public holidays if you wish
  • Competitive salary in USD. 


Things You Should Know About SOMO

  • We are a Paid Media Performance agency. Our clients cover a broad spectrum of industries.
  • Our team is spread across AU, UK, Brazil and Argentina. Everyone is treated the same, same workers rights and benefits. With this comes the same expectation of professionalism and accountability, irrespective of the location
  • We’re very proud of our staff retention rate, our first South American Talent hired 4 years ago has grown to be an integral, senior member of the team
  • Continuous learning and improvement is a pillar of our business. We have time set aside every week for internal training and coming together as an agency to discuss

title: Recuperação de agendamento
description:
Requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo ou em andamento;
  • Perfil operacional, organizado e proativo;
  • Boa comunicação e escrita;
  • Facilidade para aprender novos processos e ferramentas;
  • Gostar de rotina, execução e acompanhamento de tarefas;
  • Ser resolutivo e empático.
  • Modelo de contratação PJ.

Benefícios

  • Benefício de Saúde;
  • Crescimento acelerado baseado em performance, não em tempo de casa;
  • Ambiente onde quem se joga de verdade é reconhecido;
  • Suas ideias chegam direto em quem lidera, sem intermediários.

Responsabilidades do dia a dia

  • Entrar em contato com pacientes que iniciaram um agendamento, mas não concluíram o processo;
  • Identificar os motivos que impediram a conclusão do agendamento e auxiliar na resolução de possíveis dúvidas ou dificuldades;
  • Conduzir conversas de forma clara, empática e persuasiva, incentivando o paciente a concluir seu agendamento;
  • Apresentar alternativas de horários, profissionais ou especialidades quando necessário, buscando facilitar a decisão do paciente;
  • Realizar contatos ativos para recuperação de agendamentos e oportunidades que não foram convertidas;
  • Registrar os contatos realizados, motivos de não conversão e resultados das abordagens;
  • Acompanhar os indicadores e resultados das ações de recuperação, buscando melhorar continuamente a conversão dos agendamentos;
  • Atuar de forma organizada e focada nas rotinas operacionais, garantindo agilidade e qualidade nos atendimentos;
  • Contribuir para o aumento da ocupação e do desempenho dos profissionais parceiros por meio da recuperação de agendamentos.


Sobre o Fácil consulta

Somos uma startup que usa a tecnologia para inovar o jeito de agendar consultas, de forma fácil, rápida e a um preço mais acessível. Nossa plataforma não só facilita o agendamento de consultas, como também oferece um plano de benefícios que proporciona até 50% de economia em consultas, exames e tratamentos odontológicos, tornando a saúde de qualidade mais acessível a todos

Somos a união de pessoas talentosas com personalidades únicas, que carregam uma mesma paixão: impactar o acesso a consultas particulares de qualidade. Por isso, nossa responsabilidade é cuidar da experiência de cada paciente, assim como de cada profissional da saúde. Sem burocracia ou entrelinhas, conectamos quem precisa a profissionais qualificados

Nosso rápido crescimento oferece um ambiente dinâmico e oportunidades contínuas de desenvolvimento profissional para todos os colaboradores. Acesse nosso site e conheça mais sobre as soluções da empresa:

Requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo ou em andamento;
  • Perfil operacional, organizado e proativo;
  • Boa comunicação e escrita;
  • Facilidade para aprender novos processos e ferramentas;
  • Gostar de rotina, execução e acompanhamento de tarefas;
  • Ser resolutivo e empático.

Benefícios

title: Product Consultant
description:
Job Title: Product Consultant- IBP Supply Planning

Location: 100% Remote (LATAM)

Job Type: Contract Position


Job Description

Own design, build, and deployment of IBP product for assigned market Act as integration point across workstreams (business, product, technical) Translate business needs into functional product requirements and process design Partner with architects and engineering teams to validate feasibility of solutions Manage and evolve the product roadmap and feature prioritization Facilitate Agile ceremonies (stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives, releases) Drive execution across scrum teams and track delivery progress Manage cross-workstream dependencies and risks Engage with stakeholders to gather requirements, validate solutions, and drive adoption Monitor and report on KPIs and product performance Ensure quality of product delivery and end-user experience Resolve conflicts and changing business priorities in a dynamic environment


Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong Supply Chain / Supply Planning domain expertise (IBP, demand planning, S&OP)
  • Hands-on experience with o9 solutions (implementation + end-user capability)
  • Experience with system implementation (o9 required)
  • Ability to create functional designs (translate business requirements into system/process solutions; no coding required)
  • Experience working closely with data engineers, architects, and solution architects
  • Strong understanding of IBP limitations and process customization for local markets
  • Experience working in Agile (Scrum) environments (ceremonies, sprint planning, delivery)
  • Ability to own product roadmap, prioritization, and delivery
  • Experience managing cross-functional teams without direct authority
  • Excellent stakeholder communication and ability to influence senior leadership 5+ years in Product Management / Product Consulting / Implementation roles CPG / demand planning experience (3+ years)


Nice to Have Skills & Experience

  • Experience with Blue Yonder (especially integration with o9)
  • Exposure to global IBP rollouts across markets
  • Background in CPG beverage industry
  • Experience working across multiple scrum teams simultaneously
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, supply chain, or quantitative field
  • Experience balancing global product models vs. local market needs

title: Arquiteto de soluções - IA Microsoft
description:
A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


O que Buscamos?


Arquiteto de soluções - IA & Intelligent Applications


Estamos buscando um(a) profissional com foco em IA aplicada no Azure. Você vai atuar diretamente com clientes, liderando engajamentos técnicos de ponta a ponta: desde o design de arquitetura até a implantação em produção de soluções inteligentes com Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio e ecossistema Microsoft AI. O foco é remover bloqueios técnicos, acelerar adoção e garantir que as soluções de IA saiam do PoC para escala real.


Requisitos Obrigatórios:


  • Experiência com Fundamentos de IA e LLMs: Entendimento sólido de como LLMs funcionam, como o tokens, contexto, temperatura, hallucination e grounding. - Experiência prática com prompt engineering: system prompts, few-shot, chain-of-thought e instrução estruturada. -Conhecimento de padrões de arquitetura de IA: RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), agentes com tool use e orquestração de múltiplos agentes. - Familiaridade com avaliação de qualidade de modelos: métricas como relevância, fundamentação e coerência.
  • Experiência com Azure AI Foundry: Criação de projetos, deploy de modelos e configuração de endpoints. - Uso do model catalog, fine-tuning e avaliação de modelos dentro do Foundry. - Configuração de grounding com Azure AI Search (indexação, chunking, estratégias de retrieval). - Integração com Azure OpenAI Service e outros modelos disponíveis no Foundry.
  • Experiência com Copilot Studio: Experiência com criação de agentes no Copilot Studio na criação de tópicos, entidades, variáveis e fluxo conversacional. - Integração de agentes com fontes de conhecimento externas (SharePoint, sites, documentos). - Configuração de actions e conexão com Power Automate para automações a partir do agente. - Publicação e deployment de agentes em canais (Teams, web, outros)
  • Experiência com Arquitetura e Cloud: Capacidade de desenhar arquiteturas orientadas a IA no Azure (AI Foundry + Search + Storage + Function/App Service). - Entendimento de segurança aplicada a IA: managed identity, RBAC, data residency, responsible AI. - Habilidade de comunicar arquiteturas técnicas para públicos técnicos e executivos.


Diferencial:

  • Experiência com Azure DevOps ou GitHub Actions para CI/CD de soluções de IA (MLOps light);
  • Familiaridade com Python para prototipagem rápida, scripts de indexação ou integração com SDKs de IA;
  • Conhecimento de Azure Functions ou Logic Apps para automação serverless;
  • Experiência com Azure API Management (APIM) para expor e governar endpoints de IA;
  • Familiaridade com conectores customizados e extensões de agente (Copilot extensibility);
  • Conhecimento de Azure SQL, Cosmos DB ou PostgreSQL para persistência em soluções de IA;
  • Experiência com Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) ou containerização de modelos/aplicações;
  • Familiaridade com monitoramento de IA: Azure Monitor, Application Insights, logging de prompts/respostas;
  • Certificação AI-102 (Azure AI Engineer Associate);
  • Certificação PL-100 / PL-200 (Power Platform);
  • Certificação AZ-204 (Azure Developer Associate);




Modelo de atuação: Home Office, mas precisa ter disponibilidade para viajar esporadicamente;

Contratação CLT


O que oferecemos?

  • Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;
  • Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Convênio com Farmácia;
  • Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;
  • Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;
  • Gympass;
  • Seguro de Vida;



Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor. Não fazemos distinção por raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade. Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas. O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD).

title: Cloud Architect
description:
Position: Azure Cloud Architect

Location: Remote - Brazil (EST time zone)

Contract: 6 month+ extensions


This is a remote role, with a preference for candidates based in the U.S. Eastern Time zone.


You’ll architect, design, build, and troubleshoot cloud solutions across a hybrid cloud platform, partnering with our Global Infrastructure, Security, Network, Enterprise, Application, and Data teams to ensure everything we ship is secure, compliant, and aligned with company standards and our global cloud strategy.


Day to day, you will:

  • Lead application modernization — re-platform and refactor workloads from IaaS to PaaS to improve scalability, cost efficiency, and maintainability.
  • Serve as Level 3 (L3) escalation for complex infrastructure issues, driving deep root-cause analysis and resolving problems that lower support tiers can’t.
  • Design secure-by-default architectures — embed zero-trust principles, defense-in-depth, identity and access management, network segmentation, and data protection into every solution from the start.
  • Partner with Security Architects on threat modeling and design reviews and ensure solutions meet Sodexo security standards and relevant compliance requirements.
  • Assess the technical impact of new solutions and how they integrate into the existing ecosystem, including impact assessments for new projects and technologies.
  • Design technical architectures with a clear focus on user experience, scalability, standardization, cost, and security.
  • Build cost-optimized designs — right-size resources, select the most cost-effective service tiers and pricing models (reserved capacity, autoscaling, PaaS consumption), and apply FinOps practices so solutions stay efficient as they scale.
  • Scope multiple concurrent projects accurately and deliver on time.
  • Identify process and knowledge gaps and work across teams to close them.
  • Map business and technology dependencies and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver solutions quickly.
  • Produce technical documentation and architecture diagrams.
  • Recommend solutions grounded in Sodexo Global Standards to keep consistency through this period of change.
  • Advise on how and where Cloud Platforms can be used across the Sodexo ecosystem and guide architectural choices in line with global standards.
  • Deliver end-to-end cloud infrastructure architectures and designs using modern capabilities such as PaaS.
  • Partner with architects across other disciplines (Enterprise, Data, Security, Network, Application) and engage the broader Cloud Competency Center community across regions.
  • Manage partner relationships and coordinate development efforts across multiple teams.
  • Champion the architectural standards set by the Global Cloud Competency Center and ensure alignment with global Enterprise Architecture principles.


Required

  • Azure architecture expertise — proven ability to design and implement cloud infrastructure, platforms, and applications.
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305) or equivalent.
  • 5+ years in an Azure architecture role spanning IaaS, PaaS, and integrations.
  • 10+ years overall in cloud and IT infrastructure architecture.
  • Hands-on experience modernizing applications from IaaS to PaaS — re-platforming and refactoring workloads onto managed Azure services.
  • Experience with Azure AI services and assets — e.g., Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI Search, and Cognitive Services — including how to architect, integrate, and secure them within the enterprise landing zone.
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues such as L3 escalation, including root-cause analysis through resolution.
  • Strong grasp of cloud security architecture: identity and access management (Microsoft Entra ID / RBAC), network security (segmentation, NSGs, private endpoints, firewalls), encryption at rest and in transit, key management, tenant isolation, vulnerability management, and SIEM.
  • Hands-on with Azure-native security and governance tooling — Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, Key Vault, Azure Policy — and secure landing zone design.
  • Hands-on background administering Windows Server, Linux, and the Azure Portal.
  • Cloud cost optimization / FinOps experience — cost modeling, right-sizing, resource tagging and governance, and using Azure Cost Management to track, forecast, and reduce spend.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps in a Scrum or Agile environment.
  • Solid understanding across cloud and infrastructure components — servers, virtualization, storage, network, data, and applications — to deliver true end-to-end designs.
  • Solid understanding of operating systems and networking. Experience in Window and Linux OS.


How you work

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • A strong problem-solver — you analyze issues clearly, communicate well with colleagues, and drive to quick, sound conclusions.
  • Adaptable and curious — comfortable picking up new technologies quickly.

title: Application Assistant I
description:
Make this the place where you grow!


Como NTT DATA Business Solutions, somos mais do que apenas uma empresa. Somos uma equipe de pessoas apaixonadas que impulsionam a inovação – desde consultoria e implementação até serviços gerenciados e muito mais. Com a SAP no nosso núcleo e um poderoso ecossistema de parceiros como Microsoft e ServiceNow, continuamos aprimorando soluções e tecnologias baseadas em IA para que funcionem para as empresas – e para suas pessoas,


Com operações em mais de 30 países e reunindo 18.500 especialistas representando mais de 90 países, permitimos que milhares de empresas se tornassem mais eficientes e eficazes nas últimas três décadas.

Fazemos parte da NTT DATA, líder de US$ 30+ bilhões em serviços empresariais e tecnológicos, IA e infraestrutura digital, atendendo 75% da Fortune Global 100. Co-inovamos soluções com clientes e parceiros globalmente para impacto empresarial e social. Como um dos principais empregadores globais, a NTT DATA conta com especialistas em mais de 70 países. A NTT DATA faz parte do Grupo NTT.


Conosco, você tem infinitas oportunidades para pensar grande, agir com ousadia e assumir a responsabilidade. Faça deste o lugar onde você pertence, aprende e constrói sua rede. Make this the place where you grow!

Estamos em busca de um(a) Assistente de Aplicação para atuar no time de Customer Success, contribuindo diretamente para a excelência no atendimento ao cliente, análise de documentos fiscais e evolução contínua de nossos processos e soluções.


Principais Responsabilidades:


• Realizar a análise e o processamento de Notas Fiscais, boletos e faturas na ferramenta GUEPARDO APP Cloud;

• Atuar em grupos de apoio ao cliente, esclarecendo dúvidas e orientando sobre a utilização da plataforma;

• Configurar e automatizar regras de leitura de documentos por meio de expressões regulares (Regex), otimizando o reconhecimento automático dos arquivos;

• Contribuir para a evolução contínua dos processos de Customer Success e da experiência dos clientes.


Requisitos:


• Ensino superior completo ou cursando em Ciências Contábeis / Contabilidade;

• Conhecimento em documentos fiscais, com capacidade de entendimento, leitura e validação de Notas Fiscais;

• Boa comunicação verbal e escrita;

• Perfil analítico, organizado e com atenção aos detalhes.



Diferenciais:


• Conhecimento em Regex (Expressões Regulares);

• Experiência em áreas de Customer Success, Suporte ao Cliente ou Implantação.



Regime de Contratação: CLT

Modelo de Trabalho: Home Office


Somos a maior empresa de consultoria SAP do mundo para empresas de médio porte. Torne-se um especialista trabalhando em grandes projetos. Com as parcerias SAP Platinum, Microsoft e AWS, impulsionamos a inovação e adotamos novas tecnologias. Com a nossa visão e ambição, entregamos desempenho de alta performance.


*Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Senior 3D Game Artist / Technical Artist (Unity)
description:
About Legends of Learning


Legends of Learning is an innovative educational technology company committed to transforming learning through gameplay. We offer a vast collection of curriculum-aligned games for elementary through middle school students designed to promote engagement, comprehension, and enthusiasm for learning. These games are presented to the students inside our immersive educational game world, called Awakening.


Over 1 million students use Awakening every month. Our mission is to make education fun and accessible for all students, empowering educators with creative teaching tools that complement traditional classroom instruction.


Legends of Learning sources talent globally to contribute to our business in the United States. This position is a work-from-home role based in Brazil. Complete fluency in English is required – reading, writing, and speaking. Conversational and writing skills need to be exceptional.


Job Summary

We are looking for a Senior 3D Game Artist / Technical Artist to own the art for our Unity-based educational game world. In this role, you will create stylized characters, props, environments, and visual effects while ensuring everything runs smoothly within tight web and mobile performance budgets.


What You'll Do


  • Asset Creation: Model, texture, and maintain 3D characters, props, creatures, and environments.
  • Modular Systems: Build and rig modular avatar components (clothing, hair, accessories, and full-body morphs) tailored to our shared character rig.
  • Technical Art & VFX: Create real-time effects (particles, trails, custom shaders) and set up efficient, consistent materials across the game.
  • Optimization: Define and enforce strict art standards for poly counts, texture memory, and overall performance on mobile devices and web browsers.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with engineers for seamless asset integration, and review deliverables from external contractors to maintain quality and consistency.


What We're Looking For


  • Experience: 5+ years of 3D art experience with a proven track record of shipped Unity games (mobile and/or web preferred).
  • Core Skills: Strong foundation in modeling, rigging, UV mapping, texturing, and material setup.
  • Unity Expertise: Deep comfort level with Unity, specifically the Universal Render Pipeline (URP), and a solid understanding of mobile/browser optimization.
  • Character Systems: Hands-on experience with skinned clothing and customizable character pipelines.
  • Leadership: A highly responsible team player capable of owning the art pipeline and setting technical standards.
  • Communication: Fluent in English with the ability to communicate complex technical art concepts clearly.
  • Portfolio: A strong demo reel or portfolio showcasing stylized 3D game art, real-time effects, and optimized topology. Please include a link with your application.


Nice To Have


  • Experience shipping educational or children’s games.
  • Familiarity with version control systems.
  • An interest in contributing to game design and early-stage concepting.


What We Offer


  • Competitive salary.
  • Flexible, fully remote work environment.
  • Opportunities to collaborate with a talented team of game developers and designers.
  • A chance to be part of an innovative company creating educational games that make a real impact on student learning.


Location


This is a remote position.


Compensation


$5,000 per month


Working Hours


M-F, 40 hours per week


How To Apply


Please email your cover letter, resume, a portfolio link, and a (no more than) two minute video sharing your interest in the position to .

description:
Vaga de Trabalho


Inscrição : e cole no navegador).


Condições da vaga

  • Nível Pleno; Cargo: Consultor Jurídico em Proteção de Dados e Compliance.
  • me CLT; Modalidade home office; contrato de experiência por 3 meses.
  • Jornada: 8 horas por dia, 5 dias por semana (horários a combinar); 40 horas semanais.
  • Remuneração - durante a experiência: 3 salários-mínimos; após efetivação: 3,5 salários-mínimos; evolução conforme Plano de Carreira.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Bacharelado em Direito;
  • Experiência na área de proteção de dados, de no mínimo 1 ano;
  • Ao menos uma certificação EXIN, ITCerts ou IAPP;
  • Boa redação técnica;
  • Capacidade de comunicação com clientes;
  • Organização, autonomia e disciplina para trabalho remoto;
  • Interesse real por LGPD, compliance e segurança da informação;
  • Alinhamento com a Cultura ICNR (“fit cultural”). Para saber se você tem isso, leia nosso Código de Cultura


Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)

  • Trilhas completas de certificação;
  • Pós-graduação em área relacionada;
  • Experiência com cartórios (serventias extrajudiciais);
  • Participação em eventos, cursos, treinamentos na área;
  • Publicações técnicas.


Etapas do processo seletivo

O processo seletivo será realizado em quatro etapas:


  • Triagem de currículos.
  • Preenchimento de formulários de múltipla escolha para mensurar conhecimento técnico, alinhamento cultural e perfil DISC.
  • Resposta a questionário breve com perguntas abertas e discursivas.
  • Entrevistas.


A seleção buscará avaliar não apenas o conhecimento técnico, mas também o alinhamento com a cultura do ICNR, a maturidade profissional, a capacidade de entrega, a comunicação e a aderência à rotina consultiva.


Quem somos

O ICNR é uma consultoria especializada no atendimento a cartórios e empresas, com atuação majoritária em proteção de dados. Também desenvolvemos projetos de compliance anticorrupção, antissuborno, prevenção à lavagem de dinheiro e segurança da informação. 


Embora também atue com empresas, o principal eixo de trabalho do ICNR está no setor extrajudicial, no qual já atendemos mais de 160 cartórios em 20 estados, com reconhecimento construído tanto no mercado quanto em espaços institucionais ligados à atividade notarial e registral.


A equipe do ICNR reúne profissionais com experiência prática, produção técnica e atuação autoral na área. Para novos consultores, a oportunidade envolve crescimento profissional em temas regulatórios complexos, contato com clientes exigentes e participação em entregas que exigem estudo, responsabilidade, boa comunicação e compromisso com qualidade.


O que esperamos

Estamos em busca de um Consultor Jurídico em Proteção de Dados e Compliance, em nível pleno, para integrar nossa equipe em regime CLT e modalidade home office. 


A pessoa selecionada atuará em projetos consultivos, elaboração de documentos técnicos, atendimento a clientes, treinamentos, reuniões, análise de riscos, apoio em demandas relacionadas à LGPD, segurança da informação e compliance, na maior parte das vezes para atender clientes do nicho de cartórios extrajudiciais.


Buscamos uma pessoa com experiência em proteção de dados e/ou compliance, raciocínio jurídico-prático, capacidade de organização e gestão de projetos, além de boa escrita e comunicação clara com clientes. 


Acima de tudo, buscamos alguém com vontade de trabalhar, que ame a área de proteção de dados e que queira se desenvolver nela.
