title: Quality system engineer
description:
Quality System Engineer (ISO Management Representative)Site Based role at our CKD site based in Manaus The role: The Quality System Engineer is responsible for establishing, implementing, maintaining, and continuously improving the Quality Management System (QMS) for the motorcycle manufacturing plant. This role will lead ISO certification activities, coordinate internal and external audits, and act as the official Management Representative (MR) for ISO certification and compliance. Additionally, the position tracks and resolves manufacturing non-conformances by leading failure analysis and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) across assembly lines to prevent defect recurrence. Finally, the incumbent establishes plant-wide quality training programs and standard operating procedures (SOPs) to ensure engineering teams maintain rigorous process standardization. Responsibilities: Lead implementation and maintenance of ISO Quality Management Systems across all plant functions. Act as Management Representative (MR) for ISO certification, surveillance, and recertification audits. Coordinate ISO audits with certification bodies, consultants, and internal departments. Develop and maintain quality manuals, SOPs, work instructions, procedures, and quality records. Ensure compliance with ISO standards, statutory requirements, and customer requirements. Plan and conduct internal quality audits and process audits. Track audit observations, non-conformities, corrective actions, and preventive actions. Conduct management review meetings and prepare system performance reports. Drive continuous improvement initiatives for process standardization and system effectiveness. Provide ISO system and audit training to employees across departments. Monitor process compliance in production, warehouse, procurement, HR, maintenance, and administration. Support CAPA implementation, risk assessment, and process improvement activities. Coordinate document control, calibration systems, and record management. Ensure plant readiness for customer audits and regulatory inspections. Experience/ Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Quality Management, or related field Minimum 5–8 years’ experience in ISO systems implementation and quality management. Strong knowledge of ISO 9001 standards and audit processes. Experience in manufacturing industry, preferably automotive or motorcycle sector. Knowledge of SAP or ERP systems preferred. Certified Internal Auditor or Lead Auditor preferred. Royal Enfield - About Us: The oldest motorcycle brand in continuous production, Royal Enfield has created beautifully crafted motorcycles since 1901. From its British roots, a manufacturing plant was established in Madras in 1955, a foothold from which Royal Enfield spearheaded the growth of India’s middleweight motorcycle segment. Royal Enfield is engaging, uncomplicated, accessible and fun to ride;
a medium for exploration and self-expression. It’s an approach to the brand called Pure Motorcycling. Royal Enfield’s premium motorcycle line-up caters to varied aspirations and motivations. From stylish retro and neo-retro roadsters like the Hunter 350, the Interceptor 650 and the Shotgun 650, to quintessentially thoroughbred cruisers like the Meteor 350, and the Super Meteor 650;
and fromadrenaline pumping machines like the all-new Himalayan 450 adventure tourer, the Scram 411 ADV crossover and the Continental GT 650 cafe racer, to the timeless and iconic classics, like the Bullet and the Classic 350;
Royal Enfield has an enviable portfolio of motorcycles. Riders and a passionate community are fostered with a rich profusion of events at a local, regional and international level. Most notable are Motoverse (previously Rider Mania), an annual gathering of thousands of Royal Enfield enthusiasts in Goa, and series of epic rides ranging from peaceful and picturesque to the treacherous and challenging that test the mettle of the rider and the machine, and at the same time deepen the bond between them. A division of Eicher Motors Limited, Royal Enfield operates through more than 2000 stores across all major cities and towns in India and through nearly 1080 stores in more than 65 countries around the globe. Royal Enfield has two world-class Technology Centres, in Bruntingthorpe, UK, and in Chennai, India. The company’s worldclass, state-of-the-art production facilities are located at Oragadam and Vallam Vadagal near Chennai, along with its legacy facility at Thiruvottiyur, which was Royal Enfield’s first modern manufacturing facility in India, set-up in 1955. title: Especialista em auditoria de dados (data analytics)
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições:
Como será o seu desafio?
Desenvolver, aplicar e documentar metodologias de análise de dados, mineração de informações e monitoramento contínuo, em conformidade com as normas e regras da Auditoria Interna. Assegurar a integridade, confiabilidade e confidencialidade dos dados utilizados, respeitando leis, regulamentos e políticas internas de governança da informação • Apoiar a execução do Plano Anual de Auditoria Interna (PAINT) por meio de análises preditivas, identificação de padrões anômalos e avaliação de riscos emergentes. Apoiar o CAE (Chief Audit Executive - Diretor de Auditoria Interna) e os gestores de auditoria na implementação de novas tecnologias e ferramentas, ampliando a capacidade de monitoramento e antecipação de riscos. :
Experiência prévia em auditoria interna, analytics, gestão de riscos, ciência de dados ou áreas correlatas. Capacidade de comunicação clara, visão crítica, inovação, pensamento analítico e compromisso com o desenvolvimento profissional contínuo.

title: Product process and strategy expert
description:
About the Role
Join a high-growth, fast-moving team at the forefront of Keeta's digital operations in Brazil. You'll own end-to-end transformation projects, from designing workflows to building AI-powered tools with direct impact on merchant experience and platform scalability.
Responsibilities
Business Launch & Operational Foundation:
Own the 0-to-1 launch of merchant onboarding and operations projects. Rapidly define, implement, and iterate operational workflows that directly support business growth targets building the foundation. Digital Transformation & Tool-Based Scalability:
Drive the end-to-end shift from manual to digital operations. Translate proven workflows into scalable, tool-based solutions, including AI-powered agents to build sustainable and self-running processes. Cross-Functional Execution:
Serve as the connective tissue between frontline operations and internal teams (Strategy, Data, Product). Translate business needs into actionable priorities and drive alignment across functions to deliver results at pace. Data Framework & Performance Monitoring:
Design and own the data infrastructure for operational visibility, defining key metrics, monitoring online coverage and process completion rates, and delivering structured daily/weekly reporting to support decision-making. Issue Resolution & Experience Improvement:
Proactively surface and resolve system pain points through frontline feedback loops. Continuously improve the onboarding and operational experience for both merchants and internal users. Team Enablement & Knowledge Management:
Build the operational knowledge base — SOPs, training materials, and hands-on sessions — to ensure consistent, high-quality execution across the team as it scales.
Qualifications
5+ years in strategy, operations, product or process management roles with a track record of not just executing, but designing systems and solving ambiguous problems from the ground up. Proficient in SQL for data extraction and analysis. Ability to write basic scripts (Python or Java Script) for process automation. Hands-on experience building AI Agents or AI-driven productivity tools is a strong plus. Background in Food Delivery or On-Demand Delivery platforms, with solid understanding of the merchant lifecycle — from onboarding through retention. Direct experience working with Brazilian PDV (Point of Sale) merchants is highly valued. English communication proficiency is required

GOOGLE DRIVE ( abrir o drive, pastas, compartilhar), GOOGLE CALENDAR (saber abrir um compromisso).

Das aulas para alunos a partir de 8 anos, adultos, senior. Inglês geral, viagens, negócios e reforço escolar. Apenas seguir o método e planos de aulas. Corrigir os temas e assessments dado aos alunos. Escrever feedbacks mensais sobre os alunos (enviamos a ele)

title: Estagiário(a) em marketing | social media e criação
description:
O desafio que te espera
Você é uma pessoa criativa, que os outros costumam dizer que é "cronicamente online" e gosta de transformar ideias em conteúdos que chamam atenção?
Tem iniciativa para colocar a mão na massa, testar formatos diferentes e buscar referências sem precisar esperar alguém dizer exatamente o que fazer?
É ligada nas redes sociais, gosta de gravar vídeos, e quando chegam com uma novidade/notícia, você já estava sabendo dela muito antes de todo mundo?
Se você respondeu sim, essa vaga pode ser para você.
A Best Content é uma startup em crescimento acelerado, e buscamos alguém que queira aprender, evoluir e crescer junto com a empresa.
Aqui, você não vai entrar apenas para executar uma lista de posts. Queremos alguém que participe das ideias, ajude a construir a presença da marca e tenha espaço para testar novos formatos, acompanhar resultados e desenvolver suas habilidades na prática.
Você terá contato próximo com os times de Social Media, Design, Growth e Produto, participando de discussões sobre campanhas, lançamentos, funcionalidades e novas formas de comunicar a Best Content.
Sobre a Best Content AI
Toda empresa sabe que precisa produzir conteúdo com frequência — mas poucas conseguem manter uma presença constante, relevante e alinhada à própria marca. Produzir dá trabalho: exige tempo, repertório, organização e um monte de ferramenta diferente. Pra pequenos negócios, manter esse ritmo é caro, lento e difícil de escalar.
É esse problema que a gente resolve!
A Best Content é uma plataforma de inteligência artificial que cria, planeja e distribui conteúdos para redes sociais, adaptados à identidade visual e ao tom de voz de cada negócio.
Na prática, ajudamos empresas a transformarem suas ideias em conteúdos, carrosséis, stories, vídeos, criativos e campanhas de forma muito mais rápida, organizada e escalável. Ajudamos empresas de todos os portes desde o planejamento até o acompanhamento dos resultados gerados.
Nosso objetivo é claro: nos tornar a IA de marketing e criação de conteúdo mais usada do Brasil.
O que você vai fazer
Seu papel será ajudar a fortalecer a presença digital da Best Content, transformando ideias, novidades, estratégias e funcionalidades da empresa em conteúdos relevantes para as nossas redes sociais.
No dia a dia, você vai: Apoiar a criação e a produção de conteúdos
para Instagram, Tik Tok, Reels, Linked In e outros canais - Participando da criação e às vezes aparecendo no conteúdo; Pesquisar tendências, referências, creators e formatos
relevantes pro nosso público — e adaptá-los ao contexto da marca; Organizar o calendário editorial
e apoiar o planejamento das publicações; Sugerir novas ideias
, campanhas, quadros e formatos para as redes sociais da marca; Utilizar ferramentas de inteligência artificial
para pesquisar, organizar informações, desenvolver ideias, criar roteiros e otimizar a produção de conteúdo; Trabalhar em conjunto
com os times de Design, Growth, Produto e com as lideranças da empresa; Apoiar o contato com creators e parceiros
, ajudando na pesquisa de perfis e em ações de conteúdo em conjunto. Ajudar a organizar referências
, aprendizados e boas práticas para tornar nosso processo de criação cada vez mais eficiente.
O que buscamos
Não esperamos que você já saiba tudo. Essa é uma vaga de estágio, e buscamos alguém com vontade real de aprender, experimentar e evoluir. Buscamos uma pessoa com: Boa comunicação e escrita; Criatividade e repertório de redes sociais; Interesse por marketing, conteúdo, tecnologia e inteligência artificial; Facilidade para identificar tendências e altamente conectado; Um perfil analítico, que não apenas executa as demandas mas também busca entender padrões no que se gerou de resultado; Organização para acompanhar demandas, conteúdos e prazos; Proatividade para pesquisar, sugerir ideias e colocar projetos em prática; Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe, ouvir diferentes pontos de vista e receber feedbacks; Curiosidade para aprender sobre produto, comportamento do público e estratégias de comunicação; Responsabilidade e autonomia para conduzir suas próprias demandas com acompanhamento do time; Disponibilidade para um encontro presencial semanal no Ninna Hub, em Fortaleza.
O que seria um UAU
Não é obrigatório, mas conta pontos: Já ter criado conteúdo pra redes, mesmo em projeto pessoal (portfólio, perfil, canal, collab); Experiência com Tik Tok, Reels ou vídeos curtos, e facilidade diante da câmera; Familiaridade com Cap Cut, Canva, Premiere ou ferramentas similares; Experiência com planejamento e calendário editorial; Noção de métricas de Instagram e Tik Tok; Já ter usado ferramentas de IA aplicadas à criação de conteúdo; Interesse pelo universo de startups, tecnologia e produtos digitais; Participação em Empresa Júnior, projetos de extensão, PET, CEMP ou iniciativas estudantis;
Como a gente trabalha
Trabalho remoto, com um encontro presencial por semana no Ninna Hub, em Fortaleza; Ambiente de startup em crescimento acelerado, no qual novas ideias podem ser testadas rapidamente; Contato direto com as pessoas que tomam as decisões — aqui você aprende rápido e acompanha a estratégia por dentro; Espaço para aprender, experimentar formatos, sugerir ideias e participar das decisões de conteúdo; Acesso às principais ferramentas de inteligência artificial do mercado para utilizar no seu dia a dia; Trabalho próximo aos times de Social Media, Design, Growth e Produto; Possibilidade real de desenvolvimento e crescimento dentro da empresa; Construção de PDIs semestrais, com objetivos claros e acompanhamento da sua evolução profissional; Possibilidade de receber vesting — participação na empresa — mediante performance, evolução e entregas; Ambiente com espaço para assumir novas responsabilidades conforme seu desenvolvimento; Um time aberto a novas ideias, referências e formas diferentes de fazer as coisas.
Sobre a candidatura
Para se candidatar, envie seu currículo e alguma amostra do seu trabalho (caso tenha).
Pode ser um portfólio, perfil de rede social, vídeo, roteiro, publicação, projeto acadêmico ou qualquer outro material que mostre um pouco da sua criatividade e da sua capacidade de comunicação.
Não precisa ser algo profissional. Queremos conhecer como você pensa, pesquisa, cria e transforma ideias em conteúdo.

title: Global sales support specialist (contractor)
description:
Role Description
The Global Sales Support Specialist (GSS) is a critical driver of revenue within the Sales Finance organization, empowering the Field Sales Team with expert support in complex quoting, order processing, and product configuration. As a subject matter expert, the GSS ensures seamless deal execution while collaborating across functions to streamline processes and maximize efficiency.
This fast-paced role demands a proactive, highly organized individual who thrives under pressure. The GSS directly engages with internal sales and business operations teams to optimize sales execution, enable new product introductions, and keep quoting operations running smoothly and effectively. Location - Sao Paulo - HYBRID/ 3 days in office or 70% in office throughout the month Duration - 12 months
Your Impact This position calls for someone who possesses good communication skills, sense of ownership, proactiveness and maturity working with confidential and sensitive information. This person is a self-starter, flexible, has a high level of integrity and quick to action in a fast-paced, team-oriented, collaborative environment.
Sales Support Excellence: Support the Field Sales Team with quoting complex deals, responding to order inquiries, and providing guidance on product configurations in SFDC CPQ. Facilitate training on quote-to-order processes, including SFDC quoting sessions, ensuring that our Sales team members are equipped with the knowledge needed to drive sales success. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with teams including Deal Review, Pricing, Product, Sales Operations, and IT to ensure the smooth implementation of business policies, scalable quoting processes, and GTM offerings in SFDC CPQ. Process Documentation & Best Practices: Collaborate with the documentation team to ensure that our quoting decks are accurate, well-structured, and aligned to drive sales success. Act as a Subject Matter Expert in new product introductions, helping to design and refine quoting best practices for both new and existing products, ensuring clarity and consistency across all enablement materials. System & Process Improvement: Serve as a key partner in driving business requirements for system enhancements in SFDC CPQ, actively participating in the testing and UAT process to ensure new functionalities align with business needs. Identify and escalate system gaps or opportunities for process improvements, collaborating to streamline workflows and eliminate inefficiencies. GTM Readiness & Operational Coordination: Ensure the operational readiness of new GTM offers by collaborating with cross-functional teams to enable seamless execution of new product offerings. Build strong relationships with internal teams (Product, Sales, Legal, IT, etc.) to ensure alignment and smooth quoting processes. Project Management & Communication: Work with business partners to define objectives, set timelines, and track the status of quoting changes. Communicate milestones, dependencies, and project status updates to key stakeholders to ensure alignment and project success. Prioritization & Execution: Manage a shared mailbox for Global Sales Support activities, prioritizing requests based on revenue impact, customer relationship considerations, and timing requirements to meet deadlines.
Your Experience
Experience: 5+ years of experience in Sales Support, Sales Operations, Finance, or Contract Management, preferably in a Saa S or subscription-based business. Proven experience with Pricing/Quoting processes and an understanding of GTM strategies. Technical Proficiency: Strong experience with Salesforce (SFDC CPQ) and proficiency with Google Suite (Gmail, Sheets, Docs, etc.) is essential. A tech-savvy mindset and ability to navigate complex systems to enhance quoting processes. Communication & Collaboration: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with customers, internal teams, and International stakeholders. Ability to balance individual tasks while supporting team priorities in a dynamic environment. Organizational & Analytical Skills: Extremely detail-oriented with a high level of organization and the ability to manage multiple competing priorities simultaneously. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to analyze processes and suggest improvements. Additional Requirements: Ability to work extended hours as needed, particularly around month-end or quarter-end workloads. Flexibility to work alternate shifts to accommodate global requests and ensure timely support. Language:
Fluent English, Spanish and Portuguese.

We have the vision of a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. These aren’t easy goals to accomplish — but we’re not here for easy. We’re here for better. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

title: Human resources manager
description:
Why Valmont
We’re Here to Move the World Forward.
Valmont impacts millions of people around the world every day, yet they might not realize the many ways. Our technology is helping feed the growing population, supplying the world with more reliable energy and access to renewables, enhancing connectivity in remote and urban locations to create a sustainable future and so much more. Simply put, Valmont is advancing agricultural productivity and reimagining vital infrastructure to make life better.
Join a
Fortune
1000 company that respects hard work, honors diversity and invests in our employees as we focus on creating the world of tomorrow, today.
We are the modern workforce. Are you ready to move the world forward? Apply now.
Brief Summary of Position:
The Human Resources Manager is responsible for leading the full spectrum of Human Resources activities for the business unit, acting as a strategic business partner to leaders while ensuring operational excellence and compliance with corporate policies and local legislation. This role drives organizational effectiveness by leading talent acquisition, compensation and benefits, payroll oversight, employee relations, leadership development, performance management, succession planning, workforce planning, labor relations, compliance, and employee engagement initiatives. The position also partners closely with corporate HR Centers of Excellence and business leadership to align people strategies with organizational objectives. The HR Manager ensures compliance with labor legislation, corporate governance standards, and Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) requirements while fostering a high-performance culture focused on continuous improvement, operational excellence, and employee development. The HR Manager will lead and develop the local HR team, ensuring high performance and capability building.
Essential Functions: Strategic HR Business Partnership Partner with business leaders to develop and execute people strategies aligned with organizational goals. Provide coaching and guidance to managers on leadership, organizational design, talent management, employee relations, and performance. Support organizational transformation, change management initiatives, and workforce planning. Develop and implement HR policies, procedures, and best practices aligned with corporate guidelines and local legislation. Talent Management Lead talent acquisition activities, including recruitment strategy, selection, onboarding, and workforce planning. Drive Performance Management, Talent Review, Succession Planning, Individual Development Plans (IDPs), and employee survey action planning. Coordinate leadership development initiatives and training programs to strengthen organizational capabilities. Manage internship and early career programs, ensuring development and succession pipeline. Compensation, Benefits & Payroll Oversee payroll administration, ensuring compliance with legal requirements and corporate standards. Manage salary structures, job evaluations, compensation reviews, incentive programs, and annual merit processes. Partner with Corporate Compensation on job grading and organizational structure. Review and optimize employee benefits programs considering market competitiveness and cost effectiveness. Manage the HR budget, headcount planning (AOP), labor costs, and workforce analytics. Employee Relations & Labor Compliance Monitor labor legislation and recommend proactive actions to minimize legal exposure. Partner with Legal to manage labor litigation and develop strategies to mitigate legal risk and financial exposure. Lead labor relations activities, including collective bargaining negotiations in partnership with Legal. Ensure full compliance with labor, social security, tax, and statutory obligations. Support investigations, disciplinary actions, conflict resolution, and employee engagement initiatives.
HR Operations & Compliance Ensure compliance with payroll, timekeeping, attendance management, and statutory reporting. Monitor HR metrics and KPIs. Leverage HR analytics to drive data-informed decisions related to turnover, absenteeism, overtime, engagement, recruitment effectiveness, and organizational health. Maintain HR processes, systems, records, and documentation in accordance with internal controls and audit requirements. Support internal and external audits.
Health, Safety & Well-being Partner with EHS leadership to promote a strong safety culture. Support occupational health initiatives, wellness programs, legal compliance, and workplace safety practices. Ensure HR processes align with Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) standards and corporate requirements.
Required Qualifications: Education
Bachelor's Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology or related field. Postgraduate degree or MBA is preferred.
Experience Minimum of 7 years of progressive Human Resources experience. Experience in multinational manufacturing or industrial environments. Experience supporting senior leadership teams. Proven experience leading strategic and operational HR initiatives.
Technical Knowledge Brazilian Labor Legislation (CLT) Payroll Administration and Labor Compliance Compensation & Benefits Performance Management Talent Acquisition Learning & Development Organizational Development Workforce Planning Employee Relations Labor Union Negotiations HR Analytics & KPIs Budget and Financial Management Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) HRIS systems and Microsoft Office
Languages: Fluent English (mandatory).

This is a pipeline opportunity for proactive candidates interested in joining a global leader in the life sciences industry. The Clinical Research Associate (CRA) is responsible for overseeing clinical trials and ensuring compliance with protocols, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and regulatory requirements. The CRA monitors the progress of clinical studies conducted at investigative sites and ensures that data is collected, recorded, and reported accurately.

Prepare and maintain accurate monitoring reports and documentation. Communicate findings and follow-up activities to stakeholders.

title: Supervisor técnico de tubulação
description: Sobre a Gruen Fundada no Brasil em 2020, com sede em São Paulo, a Gruen conta com um time de engenharia atuando tanto localmente quanto na Alemanha o que assegura o desenvolvimento do processo mais eficiente para cada projeto. Nossa missão é entregar a melhor tecnologia para purificação de biogás com o menor consumo de energia entre todos os processos disponíveis no mercado. Nossas soluções são específicas e feitas sob medida de acordo com a necessidade dos nossos clientes: pré-tratamento do gás, remoção de CO2 e N2, optional CO2 capture and storage ou liquefação, Liquefação de CH4 ou compressão de 250bar – desde o projeto inicial até a gestão da operação da planta, garantindo satisfação total de nossos clientes. Fabricação e assistência técnica locais resultam em redução de custo e aumento de eficiência. Soluções para contratos de manutenção e operação das plantas viabilizam a redução da complexidade e de custos. Verificar a conformidade dos serviços executados com desenhos, isométricos, especificações técnicas e procedimentos de montagem. Acompanhar a instalação de tubulações, suportes, válvulas, acessórios e equipamentos associados aos sistemas de gás. Acompanhar testes de pressão, estanqueidade e demais atividades de comissionamento relacionadas aos sistemas de tubulação. Apoiar a resolução de problemas técnicos durante a execução das atividades, buscando soluções que minimizem impactos no cronograma. Assegurar a correta utilização de materiais, equipamentos e recursos disponibilizados para a obra. Participar de reuniões de acompanhamento com clientes, fornecedores e empresas contratadas, apresentando o status das atividades e os principais indicadores. Qualificações Cursos técnicos em Mecânica, Tubulação Industrial ou áreas correlatas. Experiência em coordenação e fiscalização de empresas terceirizadas de montagem industrial. Vivência em projetos de redes de distribuição de gás, gasodutos, city gates ou plantas industriais. Conhecimento em leitura e interpretação de desenhos técnicos, P&ID, isométricos e fluxogramas. Experiência com testes hidrostáticos, pneumáticos, testes de estanqueidade e atividades de comissionamento. title: Pesquisador de inovação sr - formulação
description:
Sobre o Inventta ICT
Você já pensou em colocar seu talento a serviço da ciência, tecnologia e inovação no Brasil?
O Inventta ICT é um Instituto de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação dedicado a impulsionar a pesquisa científica aplicada ao setor farmacêutico. Nosso foco está no desenvolvimento de medicamentos de alta complexidade e em soluções à saúde de forma segura e sustentável, com integridade, criatividade, colaboração, qualidade e compromisso com a sustentabilidade, promovemos conexões e desenvolvemos projetos de PD&I de alto impacto.
Contamos com uma equipe multidisciplinar altamente qualificada e acreditamos na colaboração como chave para gerar valor e acelerar a inovação em saúde, com forte compromisso com a evolução biotecnológica no país.
O Dia a Dia Da Oportunidade
Nesta posição você será responsável por desenvolver, promover e implementar projetos de pesquisa e desenvolvimento de inovações em novos produtos farmacêuticos, sintéticos e biotecnológicos (incrementais e radicais), atuando desde a pesquisa científica, tecnológica e/ou patentária, e, no desenvolvimento de formulações e processos, bem como o suporte aos estudos regulatórios necessários para o registro junto aos órgãos competentes.
· Atuar na prospecção, ideação e avaliação de projetos estratégicos, explorando oportunidades de propriedade intelectual e bases científicas, elaborando relatórios e estudos de viabilidade. Conduzir discussões técnicas sobre inovações incrementais e radicais em conformidade com legislações nacionais e internacionais.
· Realizar levantamentos bibliográficos e científicos para elaboração de dossiês de desenvolvimento de produtos; definir formulações, processos e escalonamento de lotes para estudos pré-clínicos e pilotos. Suporte aos estudos de pré-formulação, métodos analíticos e estabilidade exploratória.
· Propor soluções para desafios técnicos dos projetos, acompanhar planos de ação, apoiar a seleção de fabricantes de insumos e a definição de materiais de embalagem, além do suporte a captação de fomentos para pesquisa.
· Elaborar e revisar documentos técnicos, procedimentos operacionais padrão e relatórios em conformidade com as boas práticas de fabricação e desenvolvimento. Participar de treinamentos, eventos e orientar tecnicamente pares e equipes, promovendo a disseminação de conhecimentos.
O que esperamos que você tenha para concorrer a oportunidade:
Ensino superior completo em Farmácia.
Experiência prévia em Desenvolvimento Farmacotécnico e/ou Analítico.
Desenvolvimento de Produtos Farmacêuticos, Pesquisa Científica e Inovação.
Desejável familiaridade com patentes, fomentos e gestão de projetos.
Diferencial pós-graduação ou especialização na área.
Domínio avançado do Pacote Office, para elaboração de relatórios técnicos.
Inglês avançado
Remuneração, Pacote de Benefícios:
Remuneração: compatível com o mercado. Benefícios: plano médico extensivo aos dependentes, plano odontológico; restaurante no local, vale alimentação, vale transporte, previdência privada, Total Pass e Happy Day Off de Aniversário.

description: Descrição da Empresa SUPREMO ODONTO - CENTRO ODONTOLÓGICO é uma empresa especializada em saúde e odontologia, localizada em Betim, Minas Gerais. Foco no Paciente: Habilidade em fornecer atendimento humanizado e centrado no paciente, com atenção aos detalhes para garantir excelência nos diagnósticos. Será um diferencial possuir experiência prévia em funções de avaliação e vendas. Além de conhecimentos em tecnologias odontológicas modernas.

title: Regional manager, tender management and pricing
description:
The
Regional Manager, Tender Management and Pricing
is responsible for leading both the pricing strategy and the tender management lifecycle across a defined geographic region. They oversee all aspects of pricing and bid management to drive competitive, margin‑conscious decisions across multimodal product lines. They partner closely with Sales, Operations, Procurement, and Carrier Management to develop aligned bid strategies and deliver winning tender responses. They build strong relationships with carriers, evaluate market conditions, and lead cross‑functional teams through complex RFQs, RFPs, and tender cycles. They develop regional pricing frameworks, establish best practices, and drive continuous improvement in pricing accuracy, tender quality, and commercial outcomes. They also provide strategic insights based on post‑tender evaluations, helping refine future pursuits and improve long‑term profitability.
Responsibilities Oversee and manage the complete pricing and tender lifecycle, including analysis of wins/losses, pipeline performance, and regional pricing positions. Develop and execute clear bid strategies in collaboration with sales, technical teams, and cross‑functional stakeholders, defining win themes, timelines, and resource needs. Lead and motivate cross‑functional bid teams, assigning responsibilities, tracking deliverables, and ensuring timely, high‑quality tender submissions. Conduct comprehensive reviews of RFPs, RFQs, and customer requirements to identify risks, operational considerations, and solution opportunities. Manage regional relationships with air, ocean, and ground carriers, securing competitive rates and optimizing procurement strategies. Develop regional pricing frameworks across multimodal services (ground, intermodal, air, ocean, contract logistics, etc.). Ensure pricing outputs support profitable growth, align with target margins, and reinforce customer value propositions. Partner with Operations to understand cost drivers, service capabilities, network constraints, and profitability levers. title: Regulatory and trade compliance lead (seeds & traits)
description:
Position Overview
This role leads the import, export, and domestic logistics for biological materials to support the R&D and Regulatory teams in Brazil. Operating initially as a high-level individual contributor, the Regulatory and Trade Compliance Lead will be the technical reference within the company, responsible for designing, compliance-checking, and executing the cross-border and domestic movement of research materials from scratch. Key Responsibilities Lead and execute the end-to-end import and export processes biological materials, ensuring full compliance with Brazilian and international trade regulations. Act as the primary technical interface with Brazilian authorities, particularly MAPA (Ministério da Agricultura e Pecuária) managing import permits (LI), and phytosanitary certificates. Oversee and coordinate the secure, compliant domestic transport and logistics of biological materials between R&D sites, laboratories, and field trial sites in Brazil. Partner closely with internal R&D and Regulatory Affairs teams to streamline the flow of materials needed for research, breeding, and biosafety trials. Manage external partners, including customs brokers, specialized logistics providers, and laboratories, to ensure speed and regulatory compliance in all operations. Establish internal standard operating procedures (SOPs) for trade compliance, traceability, and material handling within the organization. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Agronomy, Biology, Biotechnology, International Trade, or related disciplines. Solid hands-on experience in import/export operations within the agricultural sector, with a strong focus on seeds. Deep knowledge of MAPA regulations, phytosanitary requirements, post-entry quarantine procedures, and domestic transit rules for biological materials. Proven ability to work autonomously, build processes from the ground up, and act as a strategic advisor to scientific teams. Fluent in English; Portuguese required.

title: Regional sales representative
description:
SC — Regional Sales Representative Quectel | LATAM | Sales & Business Development
Position Details Job Title:
SC — Regional Sales Representative Department:
Sales & Business Development — LATAM Reports To:
Regional Sales Manager / Director, LATAM Location:
Santa Catarina, Brazil Work Arrangement:

Frequent travel across Santa Catarina and the LATAM region (customer visits, trade shows)
Role Overview The SC — Regional Sales Representative will be a key growth driver for Quectel LATAM, responsible for maximizing Quectel's market share in the region on Non-Cellular product lines (e.g., GNSS, Wi-Fi & Bluetooth, satellite communication, antennas) and new market segments. This will be achieved through a dedicated focus on market analysis and by winning new verticals and customers centered on these product lines. Acting as the face of Quectel in Santa Catarina, this professional will map and develop the full commercial potential of the territory — prospecting new customers, engaging underserved segments, and ensuring that every technology company in the region knows Quectel and its affiliate solutions.
Key Responsibilities Understand the needs and expectations of customers and provide relevant, solution-oriented recommendations. Prospect every new customer who uses any technology solutions within the assigned territory. Maintain a high volume of client and partner engagement, ensuring a minimum of 10 meetings per week while sustaining consistent productivity standards. Map and develop the full commercial potential of the assigned territory — going beyond well-known business clusters to identify and engage new client prospects and underserved market segments. Follow up on account designs for the assigned product lines within the Regional Funnel. Train the Quectel Sales Force and Rep Firms/Distributors on the assigned product lines and follow up on resulting opportunities. Create a Monthly Territory Discussion Report covering leads, technical evaluations, meeting plans, roadmap calls, and related activities. Operate CRM (customer relationship management) systems and ensure authentic, up-to-date information is available within the company. Visit exhibitor booths at trade shows to identify accounts and products that use cellular modules and obtain contact information. Ensure 100% of technology customers in the region/state get to know Quectel and its affiliate solutions.
Qualifications & Requirements Required Experience:
Minimum of 3 years in sales positions within the Io T segment. Educational Background:
Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in Electronic Engineering, Computer Science, Automation, Electronics & Communication, or other IT-related fields. Communication Skills:
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in Portuguese and English. Customer-Centric:
Demonstrated ability to understand and align solutions with customer business goals. Location:
Based in Santa Catarina, Brazil, with availability for frequent travel across the territory.
Preferred Knowledge of non-cellular technologies such as GNSS, Wi-Fi & Bluetooth, Lo Ra, satellite communication, and antennas. Existing relationships with OEMs, design houses, system integrators, or distributors in Southern Brazil. Experience selling into smart metering, asset tracking, smart agriculture, industrial Io T, or connected mobility verticals. Proficiency with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, Hub Spot) and standard productivity software. Spanish language skills a plus.
About Quectel Quectel is a global Io T solutions provider and the world's leading supplier of cellular and GNSS modules, with a mission to build a smarter world. Our broad portfolio spans cellular modules (5 G, LTE, LPWA), GNSS, Wi-Fi & Bluetooth and satellite communication modules, antennas, and Io T connectivity services — combined with outstanding support and services that shorten our customers' time-to-market.
With engineering, sales, and support teams across APAC, EMEA, North America, and LATAM, Quectel serves a rapidly growing base of Io T innovators worldwide. Together with ecosystem affiliates such as Acceleronix (Io T platform and Connectivity-as-a-Service), Quectel enables end-to-end solutions from module to cloud.
Life at Quectel LATAM At Quectel LATAM, no two days are the same. You'll collaborate with a diverse, globally-connected team, engage directly with some of the most innovative OEMs and enterprises in Latin America, and contribute to technologies that are redefining how devices and people connect.
Fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment backed by the resources of the global leader in Io T modules. Direct access to global R&D, product, and engineering teams across Asia, Europe, and the Americas. Regular knowledge-sharing through internal trainings, webinars, and cross-functional project teams. A culture of continuous learning — we invest in your growth because your development is our development.
Industries & Applications Quectel's Io T solutions power innovation across a wide range of industries. As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to make a real impact in:
Smart Metering & Utilities —
Electricity, water, and gas metering solutions. Asset Tracking & Logistics —
Fleet management, cold chain, and supply chain visibility. Smart Agriculture —
Precision farming, greenhouse monitoring, and livestock tracking. Smart Cities & Infrastructure —
Street lighting, parking, public safety, environmental monitoring. Industrial Io T & Automation —
Predictive maintenance, factory automation, condition monitoring. Connected Mobility & Automotive —
Telematics, EV charging, micro-mobility. Smart Home & Consumer Io T —
Connected appliances, energy management, security.
Why Quectel LATAM? Global Impact, Regional Focus —
Be at the forefront of Io T innovation across Latin America, backed by the global market leader with teams in APAC, EMEA, and North America. Career Growth & Development —
Access structured mentorship, international exposure, internal mobility, and clear advancement paths within a fast-growing global organization. Cutting-Edge Technology —
Work with next-generation GNSS, Wi-Fi & Bluetooth, satellite, antenna, and cellular technologies deployed in mission-critical applications. Diversity & Inclusion —
Join an inclusive, multicultural workplace where diverse perspectives are valued as key drivers of innovation and success. Global Team & Collaboration —
Collaborate with a global network of Io T experts across engineering, sales, marketing, and operations — and with the Quectel ecosystem, including Acceleronix.
Compensation & Benefits Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks. Performance bonus / sales commission structure. Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance). Health insurance with no co-pay. Life insurance. Paid time off. International travel opportunities (HQ visits, global trade shows).

title: Latam hr operations & local representative
description:
Position Summary
We are seeking a highly capable and versatile
LATAM HR Operations & Local Representative
to join our growing team in Brazil. In this dual-capacity role, you will serve as the strategic and operational HR lead for our Latin America (LATAM) region—specifically covering Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, and Mexico—while simultaneously acting as our official local legal representative for our corporate entity registration in Brazil. The ideal candidate will manage all end-to-end HR operations across the region, steer local administrative functions in Brazil, and ensure full legal and statutory compliance for our Brazilian entity. This is a critical role requiring a deep understanding of LATAM labor markets, corporate governance, and a hands-on approach to business operations.
Key Responsibilities 1. Local Corporate Representation & Administration (Brazil) Act as the official, named Local Representative for the company’s legal entity registration in Brazil. Liaise with local authorities, public agencies, notary offices (Cartórios), external legal counsel, and accountants to maintain the company’s good standing. Manage and oversee all local corporate administrative tasks, including processing legal documentation, managing corporate mail, and maintaining statutory records. Ensure strict compliance with Brazilian corporate laws, municipal regulations, and licensing requirements.
2. Regional HR Operations (LATAM) Oversee and manage the day-to-day HR lifecycle operations for employees and contractors across Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, and Mexico. Lead local onboarding and offboarding processes, ensuring a seamless experience aligned with global standards and regional requirements. Partner with centralized or regional payroll providers to ensure accurate and timely monthly payroll processing, benefits administration, and tax filings in all four jurisdictions. Maintain accurate digital employee records and ensure compliance with local data privacy laws (such as LGPD in Brazil).
3. Compliance & Labor Relations Monitor and interpret labor law updates and regulatory changes across Brazil (CLT), Colombia, Costa Rica, and Mexico to mitigate organizational risk. Manage local benefits programs (e.g., health insurance, meal vouchers, life insurance) ensuring competitive and compliant offerings in each country. Support employee relations issues, inquiries, and grievances, providing culturally nuanced and legally compliant guidance.
Required Qualifications & Skills Experience:
Minimum of 4–7 years of experience in HR Operations / People Operations, with at least 2 years managing multi-country scopes across LATAM. Legal Requirements:
Must meet all legal criteria to act as an official corporate representative/administrator in Brazil (Brazilian national or permanent resident with full legal capacity). Language Skills:
Native or bilingual fluency in Portuguese, and professional working proficiency in both English, Spanish & Portuguese (written and spoken) to effectively communicate across countries. Knowledge Base:
Strong fundamental understanding of Brazilian labor law (CLT) and corporate compliance; familiarity with labor practices in Mexico, Colombia, and Costa Rica is highly preferred. Attributes:
High level of integrity, strong organizational skills, discretion when handling confidential legal and personal data, and an ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment.

title: Ip lawyer (in-house, brazil)
description:
Hello!
We are looking for an experienced and proactive IP Lawyer to join our global legal team and lead enforcement efforts in Brazil. This is a remote-first position, offering flexibility while working closely with our international legal and business teams. However, the role requires regular attendance at court hearings, enforcement actions, and raids in São Paulo. Therefore, candidates must reside in the city of São Paulo or its metropolitan area.
You'll work directly on protecting the rights of some of the world's most recognized brands through a combination of civil, criminal, and administrative IP enforcement. The position focuses on hands-on IP enforcement, including drafting and sending claims, managing pre-litigation negotiations, coordinating enforcement actions with public authorities, representing clients in civil and criminal proceedings, and recovering monetary compensation from infringers.
Who are we?
Brand Monitor is a global legal-tech company focused on the protection of intellectual property rights across the world. We proudly represent over 450 international brands across industries such as fashion, luxury goods, electronics, and more in their fight against counterfeiting and IP violations. Our legal operations span Europe, Asia, MENA, and Latin America, and we are now expanding our legal team in Brazil.
What you will do:
Identify and monitor IP infringements throughout Brazil; Draft and send cease-and-desist letters, legal claims, and negotiate settlements; Represent rights holders in pre-litigation, civil litigation, and criminal IP proceedings; Coordinate and participate in search and seizure operations (raids) and enforcement actions with local authorities (Police, Customs, Public Prosecutor's Office, regulatory agencies, etc.); Draft and file powers of attorney, affidavits, criminal complaints, petitions, and litigation documents; Build and maintain strong relationships with law enforcement agencies, courts, investigators, and service providers; Recover monetary compensation through settlements or court decisions; Support the company's legal and business operations in Brazil (contracts, compliance, office setup, banking, and corporate matters, as needed).
What we expect from you:
Law degree and admission to the Brazilian Bar Association (OAB); Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in Intellectual Property (either in-house or at a law firm); Proven experience with IP enforcement, including: Civil litigation; Criminal IP matters, including search and seizure actions, criminal complaints, anti-counterfeiting investigations, and interactions with police and prosecutors; Experience coordinating enforcement actions with public authorities; Strong legal drafting, negotiation, and communication skills; Fluent Portuguese and professional English (written and spoken); Highly organized, proactive, and able to work independently in a global environment; Must reside in São Paulo (city or metropolitan area) due to the need for in-person attendance at courts, hearings, and enforcement operations.
What We Offer:
Work with top-tier global clients and international teams; Competitive salary; Opportunity to lead and shape Brand Monitor's legal operations in Brazil; Remote-first work environment with flexibility; Meaningful impact in the global fight against counterfeiting and intellectual property violations; Career growth within a fast-growing international legal-tech company.

description:

Hoje, contamos com 28 unidades entre operações próprias e franquias, além da nossa Cozinha Central, responsável pela produção de 90% dos nossos produtos, e do nosso escritório corporativo, que apoia toda a expansão e estratégia do negócio.

Sobre a Vaga | Analista de Supply Chain Buscamos um(a) profissional analítico(a), organizado(a) e com visão estratégica para atuar no planejamento da demanda e na gestão da cadeia de abastecimento do Cabana Burger. Você será responsável por garantir o abastecimento eficiente das lojas e da Cozinha Central, equilibrando disponibilidade de produtos, níveis de estoque e eficiência operacional. Essa posição exige forte capacidade analítica, tomada de decisão baseada em dados e interação constante com as áreas de Compras, Produção, Logística, Operações e Marketing.
Responsabilidades Elaborar projeções de demanda e pedidos das lojas com base no histórico de vendas, sazonalidade, campanhas e giro de estoque. Consolidar, revisar e validar pedidos antes do envio para Compras e Produção. Monitorar diariamente os níveis de estoque das lojas e da Cozinha Central, identificando riscos de ruptura ou excesso. Planejar e acompanhar inventários, realizando a apuração e análise das divergências de estoque. Identificar produtos de baixo giro e apoiar a definição de ações junto às áreas responsáveis. Coordenar o fluxo de informações entre Compras, Produção, Logística, Operações e Marketing durante campanhas promocionais. Projetar os impactos das campanhas sobre a demanda e ajustar o planejamento de abastecimento quando necessário. Realizar a entrada de notas fiscais e apoiar a gestão física e sistêmica do estoque da Cozinha Central. Acompanhar indicadores de Supply Chain e propor melhorias contínuas nos processos de planejamento e abastecimento.
Requisitos Ensino Superior completo ou em andamento em Administração, Engenharia de Produção, Logística ou áreas correlatas. Experiência em Supply Chain, planejamento de demanda, gestão de estoques ou operações de varejo/food service. Vivência com inventários e análise de divergências de estoque. Experiência em operações com múltiplas unidades será considerada um diferencial. Excel avançado (tabelas dinâmicas, fórmulas e análise de dados). title: Qc - manager
description: Oversee all analytical testing activities to ensure compliance with GMP, GLP, ANVISA RDC, and other applicable regulatory requirements, ensuring data integrity, accuracy, and traceability throughout all operations, maintaining the laboratory in a state of inspection readiness. title: Gestor de território
description:
Estamos em busca de um Gestor de Time de Vendas altamente qualificado para liderar e desenvolver nossa equipe de vendedores. Se você tem habilidades de liderança, é orientado a resultados e possui experiência em gestão de equipes, queremos conhecê-lo!
Responsabilidades: Liderar e gerenciar um time de vendedores, garantindo alta performance e atingimento de metas; Treinar e desenvolver a equipe de vendas, promovendo capacitação contínua; Realizar reuniões diárias, semanais e mensais para alinhamento de estratégias e acompanhamento de resultados; Identificar e tratar anomalias nos processos de vendas, propondo soluções eficazes; Participar do processo de recrutamento e seleção de novos membros para o time de vendas; Avaliar o desempenho da equipe, fornecendo feedbacks construtivos e planos de desenvolvimento individual; Analisar indicadores de desempenho e resultados de vendas, identificando oportunidades de melhoria; Propor e implementar ações de vendas para maximizar os resultados e alcançar os objetivos estabelecidos.
Requisitos e qualificações Carteira de motorista B; Experiência comprovada em gestão de equipes de vendas; Capacidade de análise de dados e indicadores de desempenho; Habilidades de liderança e capacidade de motivar e inspirar a equipe; Disponibilidade para viagens; Poder de mobilização e execução; “Espirito jovem, com muita energia”; Proatividade e foco em resultados; Ensino Superior Completo (cursos elegíveis: engenharias, economia, física, estatística, matemática, administração); Experiência comercial preferencialmente em bens de consumo, bebidas, sorvete, canal conveniência; Desejável experiência como trade (consumo ou higiene beleza).
Informações adicionais Assistência médica; Assistência odontológica; Vale refeição; Seguro de vida; PLR.
Motivos para trabalhar na Legrand: A Legrand oferece uma carreira acelerada com oportunidades de aprendizado e desenvolvimento real, em uma cultura de crescimento e meritocracia. A Legrand hoje: Empresa com mais de 100 SKUs, sendo 25 produtos líderes ou vice-líderes de mercado. Faturamento anual superior a R$1 bilhão, com destaque para o produto Expec, que gera R$300 milhões por ano. História recente: Nos últimos três anos e meio, a Legrand dobrou de tamanho, aumentou seu market share e subiu duas posições no ranking, agora sendo a terceira maior. Quintuplicou o número de colaboradores e foi certificada no ranking GTPW de melhores empresas para trabalhar nos últimos dois anos. Novo lema “Viva a Vida”, focado em criar marcas amadas pelos consumidores.

title: Customer service coordinator
description:
Coordenador(a) de Customer Care
Mauá / Santo André, SP
Esta posição terá papel estratégico na gestão da equipe de atendimento comercial, garantindo excelência na experiência do cliente, eficiência operacional e forte interface com as áreas de Vendas, Supply Chain, Finanças e Operações.
Buscamos um(a) líder com experiência em ambientes B2 B industriais, foco em melhoria contínua de processos, desenvolvimento de equipes e gestão de indicadores de desempenho. Principais Responsabilidades
Liderar, desenvolver e engajar a equipe de Customer Care. Garantir alto nível de atendimento e satisfação dos clientes. Gerenciar a carteira de pedidos e acompanhar as atividades relacionadas ao ciclo do pedido. Monitorar indicadores de desempenho da área e propor ações de melhoria contínua. Vivência em empresas industriais ou ambientes de manufatura. Conhecimento em gestão de indicadores (KPIs) e melhoria de processos. Experiência com CRM e sistemas ERP. Excel avançado. Inglês avançado. Forte capacidade analítica e orientação para resultados.

A chave do nosso sucesso e da execução de nossa estratégia 'Own the Game' ( Domine o jogo), são nossas pessoas e nossa cultura. Eles dão vida à nossa identidade, definida por nosso propósito, missão e atitude e por esse motivo sempre estamos em busca de novos talentos que possam agregar ainda mais a nossa cultura incorporando sempre a diversidade e que nos ajudem a mudar vidas através do esporte.

title: Analista de fp&a sênior
description:
Como
Analista de FP&A Sênior
você atuará como parceiro estratégico da Diretoria Financeira, apoiando o planejamento, o acompanhamento orçamentário e a geração de insights para a tomada de decisão do negócio.
Este profissional será responsável por acompanhar o desempenho financeiro frente ao orçado e projetado, e atuar como elo entre as áreas de negócio e o financeiro — recomendando ações para maior eficiência e rentabilidade.
Responsabilidades e atribuições: Planejamento e Orçamento Apoiar a governança do calendário orçamentário corporativo; Elaborar o planejamento orçamentário e o forecast do Demonstrativo de Resultados (DRE), incluindo receitas, custos, despesas e Capex; Coordenar o processo mensal de forecast, garantindo alinhamento entre áreas, consistência das premissas e acurácia dos resultados projetados; Participar da construção do orçamento anual, consolidando informações e preparando apresentações para a liderança executiva; Manter e evoluir os simuladores de projeções, atendendo a demandas de cenários adicionais; Análise e Reporte de Resultados Confeccionar, analisar e apresentar mensalmente a DRE da companhia, assegurando o cumprimento das metas de EBITDA, margem bruta, margem de contribuição e despesas; Identificar e explicar desvios entre orçado, projetado e realizado, propondo planos de ação para mitigação de riscos e captura de oportunidades; Consolidar e divulgar relatórios de acompanhamento orçamentário por área, cliente e time de negócio; Garantir a rastreabilidade e a validação dos dados reportados junto à liderança executiva. Suporte ao Negócio Atuar como ponte entre as áreas de negócio e o financeiro, fornecendo insights e recomendações para otimização de recursos; Elaborar business cases e apresentações para avaliação de novos negócios e projetos; Analisar a rentabilidade de campanhas e iniciativas comerciais (P&L), propondo planos de ação em conjunto com as áreas Comercial e de Marketing; Simular impactos financeiros de políticas comerciais (frete, descontos e promoções); Participar ativamente dos ciclos de S&OP, contribuindo com uma visão de planejamento financeiro; Apoiar processos de apuração de remuneração variável, conforme performance financeira das verticais de negócio.
Requisitos e qualificações: Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Economia, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas correlatas; Pacote Office avançado (essencial domínio de Excel); Experiência prévia com SAP; Inglês avançado (diferencial); Conhecimento em administração financeira, demonstrativos de resultado, gestão tributária, rateio de custos e planejamento orçamentário; Perfil analítico e crítico, com facilidade em modelagem de projeções.

title: Coordenador de garantia de qualidade
description:
Sobre a Empresa
Inovação e Excelência em Diagnósticos desde 1968 Há mais de cinco décadas, a Laborclin é sinônimo de qualidade e inovação em produtos para laboratórios e indústrias. Fundada em 1968, evoluímos de meios de cultura e reagentes para um portfólio diversificado com mais de 600 produtos, atendendo análises clínicas, pesquisas biológicas, indústrias de alimentos e bebidas e cosméticos. A aquisição da Laborclin pelo Grupo Solabia multinacional Francês em 2020 e Plastlabor em 2024 impulsionou nossa capacidade de P&D e presença global. Comprometidos com a excelência, somos certificados ISO 9001, e em Boas Práticas de Fabricação e Controle, garantindo produtos confiáveis e sustentáveis. Conte com nossa experiência e equipe qualificada para soluções de ponta em microbiologia e diagnósticos.
O que buscamos:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Coordenador(a) de Garantia da Qualidade com experiência comprovada na função, para integrar nossa equipe e coordenar os processos de gestão da qualidade, garantindo que os processos estejam em conformidade com os requisitos regulatórios aplicáveis, normas vigentes e diretrizes internas, promovendo a melhoria contínua e assegurando a eficácia dos sistemas da qualidade.
Principais Responsabilidades
Implementar e Assegurar que todos os requisitos do Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade sejam estabelecidos e mantidos conforme legislação vigente de Boas Práticas de Fabricação (RDC 665:2022 – ISO 9001); Relatar o desempenho do sistema de qualidade à gerência executiva para revisão e fornecer informações sobre a melhoria do sistema de gestão da qualidade; Estabelecer e manter controle de homologação de fornecedores e prestadores de serviço que afetem a qualidade dos produtos; Prestar suporte técnico e operacional às áreas de Produção, Manutenção Industrial, Laboratório, mantendo o controle dos registros de investigações e elaboração de planos de ação sempre que necessário; Esclarecer dúvidas técnicas de processos (documentação da qualidade, fluxo de processos etc.); Coordenar a execução anual de auditoria internas, bem como tratar pendências de auditorias realizadas e/ou recebidas; Coordenar e manter o controle do plano mestre de validações de processos/ Qualificações de equipamentos; Coordenar e manter o controle de não conformidades observadas e o estabelecimento de processo de investigação e definição de planos de ações; Dar suporte ao processo de investigações de desvios de qualidade dos processos, produtos e matérias-primas; Coordenar e manter o controle de documentos do sistema de gestão da qualidade e registros históricos de produção; Manter o controle dos Registros da Qualidade pelos prazos estabelecidos; Coordenar e manter o controle dos treinamentos operacionais de colaboradores; Coordenar o processo de controle de mudanças e controle de projetos de produtos conforme requisitos estabelecidos; Coordenar e manter o processo de Controle de Reclamações de Clientes; Coordenar e manter o processo de gestão de riscos de produtos conforme requisitos aplicáveis; Controlar orçamento referente as despesas do seu departamento; Fazer a Gestão de Pessoas, controle de ponto e avaliações de desempenho conforme regras estabelecidas por RH.
Requisitos da posição:
Ensino Superior completo em Farmácia, Engenharia, Química ou áreas correlatas; Experiência em coordenação da área de Garantia da Qualidade e gestão de equipes em indústria farmacêutica, diagnóstica, química ou correlatas; Conhecimento sólido em Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade (SGQ), Boas Práticas de Fabricação (BPF/GMP) e requisitos regulatórios da ANVISA; Vivência com gestão de não conformidades, CAPA, controle de mudanças, gestão de riscos, qualificação e validação; Experiência na condução de auditorias internas, externas e inspeções regulatórias; Conhecimento em indicadores de desempenho, análise de dados e melhoria contínua; Domínio do Pacote Office e experiência com sistemas ERP; Perfil analítico, organizado e orientado para resultados; Forte capacidade de liderança, comunicação, tomada de decisão e relacionamento interpessoal; Inglês avançado.
Habilidades Necessárias
Gestão de Qualidade; Coordenação de Equipes; Auditorias, ISO, ANVISA Gestão de Riscos; Comunicação Eficaz; Tomada de Decisão. Senso de urgência
Habilidades Preferenciais
Experiência em Indústria Farmacêutica; Conhecimento em ERP SAP; Inglês Avançado.

Remuneração compatível com o mercado. Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Vale Transporte; Seguro de Vida; Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Combo Bem-Estar - TOTALPASS + CLUDE + C4 LIFE.

O que esperar da oportunidade
Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e colaborativo; Oportunidade de desenvolvimento profissional; Participação em projetos estratégicos e de melhoria contínua; Cultura organizacional voltada para inovação, excelência e valorização das pessoas.

title: Field service engineer – latin america
description:
Based in São Paulo, Brazil | Full-time | Extensive regional travel
Position Summary
AV Flexologic B. V. is seeking a Field Service Engineer to join its global Service & Support division, based in São Paulo, Brazil. This role provides on-site installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair services for AV Flexologic equipment at customer sites across Brazil, Argentina, Chile, and Central America. The successful candidate will work closely with the Service & Support coordination team (Alphen aan den Rijn, Netherlands) and the Monterrey and Bangkok offices to ensure consistent, high-quality service delivery across the region.
Engagement structure
This role is structured as an independent contractor engagement: the engineer will operate through their own Brazilian legal entity (CNPJ / "PJ" — pessoa jurídica) and issue a monthly invoice (nota fiscal) to AV Flexologic for services rendered, rather than being hired as a CLT employee.
Key Responsibilities
- Perform installation, commissioning, preventive maintenance, and repair of AV Flexologic equipment at customer sites. - Diagnose and resolve technical issues in the field, escalating to engineering or product specialists as needed. - Travel regularly within the São Paulo area and across Brazil, as well as to Argentina, Chile, and Central America, for scheduled and emergency service visits. - Provide clear, timely reporting on service visits, parts usage, and customer feedback to the Service & Support coordination team. - Maintain professional communication with customers, distributors, and internal stakeholders in Portuguese, Spanish, and English. - Support training of local customer technicians where applicable. - Maintain assigned company equipment (vehicle, tools, laptop, phone) in good working order.
Travel Requirements
This is a field-based, travel-intensive role. Expected travel coverage includes:
- São Paulo metropolitan area and state (base region, most frequent travel) - Other regions of Brazil, as service demand requires - Argentina and Chile - Central America ("Middle America")
Travel frequency will vary by season and customer install base; candidates should expect travel for a significant portion of working time, including multi-day international trips. A valid passport and the ability to obtain visas/work authorizations for the above countries is required.
Candidate Requirements
- Technical degree or vocational qualification in mechanical, electrical, mechatronics, or industrial engineering (or equivalent hands-on field service experience). - Prior experience in field service, industrial equipment maintenance, or a similar customer-facing technical role. - Fluent Portuguese (native/near-native) and working proficiency in English required; Spanish strongly preferred given Argentina/Chile/Central America coverage. - Valid driver's license; comfortable with frequent independent travel. - Strong troubleshooting mindset, customer service orientation, and ability to work autonomously in the field.
Service Availability & Extra Hours
Expected availability
Equivalent to 40 hours per week
Extra hours beyond scope
Additional hours may be billed as an extra line item on the monthly invoice, or offset with reduced availability in a following period, as agreed between the parties.
Downtime & Public Holidays
Agreed annual downtime
20–25 business days per year with no invoice reduction, by mutual agreement (contractual, not statutory)
National public holidays
9 fixed federal holidays, plus movable holidays (see list below) — no service expected, no invoice reduction
Brazilian national (federal) holidays
- January 1 – New Year's Day - April 21 – Tiradentes Day - May 1 – Labour Day - September 7 – Independence Day - October 12 – Our Lady of Aparecida (Patron Saint of Brazil) - November 2 – All Souls' Day - November 15 – Republic Proclamation Day - November 20 – National Black Consciousness Day (federal holiday since 2024) - December 25 – Christmas Day
In addition, Good Friday and Corpus Christi are movable, date-dependent observances, and Carnival (February/March) is technically an optional "ponto facultativo" day rather than a mandatory holiday — in practice, it is observed by the vast majority of Brazilian employers. State and municipal holidays (e.g., São Paulo city/state-specific dates) may add further non-working days depending on exact work location. On request holidays can be traded for work days in mutual agreement.
Compensation (Monthly Invoice)
Monthly invoice amount (indicative)
Based on experience level
Travel expenses
Covered by AV Flexologic for company travel.
Equipment Provided

Especialista de Negócios

Por que fazer parte da PI Ag Sciences? Você terá a oportunidade de atuar em uma das regiões mais relevantes do agronegócio brasileiro, com autonomia regional, proximidade com o produtor e participação direta na construção e no posicionamento de tecnologias inovadoras. title: Partner management manager (commercial focus)
description:
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced and commercially driven
Partner Management Manager
to lead strategic partnerships and drive sustainable business growth. This role requires a strong commercial mindset, exceptional stakeholder management skills, and proven experience navigating complex and long sales cycles with senior decision-makers. The ideal candidate will be responsible for identifying, negotiating, and managing high-impact partnerships while owning the full partnership lifecycle—from opportunity identification and deal structuring through implementation, growth, and long-term relationship management. This is a highly cross-functional role that requires close collaboration with Operations, Product, Finance, Legal, Marketing, and senior leadership teams. Key Responsibilities Strategic Partnership Development Identify, evaluate, and develop strategic partnership opportunities aligned with company growth objectives. Build and maintain strong relationships with key external stakeholders, including C-level executives and senior decision-makers. Develop partnership strategies that create long-term commercial value and competitive advantage. Conduct market analysis to identify emerging trends, white spaces, and new business opportunities. Commercial Negotiation & Deal Management Lead complex commercial negotiations involving multiple stakeholders, long sales cycles, and sophisticated deal structures. Own the end-to-end partnership process, from prospecting and opportunity qualification to contract execution and post-launch growth. Structure and negotiate commercial agreements, pricing models, revenue-sharing frameworks, and strategic collaboration terms. Manage contract renewals, renegotiations, and expansion opportunities to maximize partner lifetime value. Drive alignment among internal and external stakeholders throughout the negotiation process. Partner Growth & Account Management Develop strategic account plans for key partners to drive revenue growth and deepen relationships. Monitor partnership performance through KPIs, business reviews, and growth initiatives. Identify upselling, cross-selling, and expansion opportunities within existing partnerships. Conduct regular business reviews with partners to ensure alignment, performance, and long-term success. Qualifications Basic Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Economics, Engineering, or related field. Experience in Business Development, Strategic Partnerships, Key Account Management, or Enterprise Sales. Proven track record of managing complex sales and negotiation cycles involving multiple stakeholders. Experience negotiating high-value commercial agreements and strategic partnerships. Strong experience managing executive-level relationships. Excellent analytical and commercial acumen.

title: Mars program — mba leadership
description:
About Keeta Keeta is the international brand of Meituan, the world's leading food delivery platform. Guided by the mission of "helping people eat better and live better," we bring 15 years of Meituan's technology and operational expertise to global markets. Since launching in 2023, we have grown from Hong Kong to the Middle East and Brazil — building real value for users, merchants, and delivery partners in every community we serve.
About Mars Program Mars Program is Keeta's flagship leadership accelerator — a strategic investment in the next generation of business leaders for Brazil. This is not a traditional hire. We are looking for high-potential talents who want to build a long-term career in Brazil, understand the food delivery business end-to-end, and grow into future leaders of this organization.
You will be assigned to one of the four core pillars of our business —
Merchant, Consumer, Delivery, and Business Analytics
— gaining a comprehensive, hands-on understanding of what it takes to build and scale a world-class food delivery platform.
What You'll Do Your responsibilities will evolve across business areas, and may include: Drive merchant acquisition, activation, and retention strategies to grow Keeta's supply-side ecosystem in Brazil. Design and execute consumer growth and retention initiatives, tailoring strategies to local user behavior and market dynamics. Optimize delivery operations — improving efficiency, rider experience, and fulfillment quality in the Brazilian market. Conduct business analysis to translate data into strategic insights, supporting key decisions across functions. Lead or contribute to cross-functional projects, collaborating with local and global teams to solve real business challenges.
What We're Looking For Education:
Full-time international MBA required. We seek candidates who have completed or are completing a full-time MBA program, bringing a global perspective and the academic foundation to lead in a complex, fast-growing market. Background:
Experience in consulting, finance, tech, fast-moving consumer goods, or management trainee programs is a strong fit. Candidates from outside the industry with demonstrated high potential are equally welcome. Language:
Fluent in Portuguese and English. Mindset:
Humble, hands-on, curious, resilient — excited by the ambiguity of building something from scratch, not just managing what's already there.
Why Join Mars Program High Starting Point
— a dual recognition of your past achievements and future potential. This is our commitment to attracting top talent. End-to-End Business Exposure
— specialize in one of our four core pillars. Build the holistic view and foundational logic of the food delivery business that most professionals spend a decade trying to piece together. Executive Mentorship & Visibility
— Enter a high-visibility talent pool with direct access to senior leadership, intensive coaching, and exposure to real strategic decisions. World-Class Methodology
— Benefit from Meituan's 15 years of deep industry know-how and scientific operating frameworks, now being applied to crack one of the world's most exciting new markets.

São Paulo, Brazil. Onboarding Target:

title: Senior revenue accountant – us gaap & process automation
description:
Accounting Data Analyst — Revenue As one of the top mobility companies in the world, we have been redefining the industry with innovative mobile technologies since 2013, driving us toward becoming a super app. Join us in our mission to combat global injustice.
We are looking for an experienced accounting professional with strong technical and data skills to join our global Accounting team. In this role, you'll prepare journal entries, account reconciliations, and revenue data packages that keep our books accurate, auditable, and US GAAP compliant — while writing the SQL and building the automation that makes those processes scalable as we prepare for public company readiness. You'll report to a US-based Revenue Accounting leader (Eastern Time) and partner daily with accounting, data, and payment reconciliation colleagues across the globe. This is a hands-on role for someone who is equally comfortable posting a journal entry in an ERP and querying a data warehouse — and who gets energized by fixing broken processes, not just running them.
What You'll Do Prepare complete, review-ready journal entries across revenue, accounts receivable, payment provider settlements, chargebacks/refunds, taxes, and intercompany — with full supporting detail for ERP posting Prepare account reconciliations, flux analyses, and supporting schedules for monthly, quarterly, and annual close Write and maintain SQL queries against our data warehouse to extract and validate the data behind accruals and ASC 606 revenue recognition Support payment service provider (PSP) reconciliations — validating settlement, refund, chargeback, and fee data across geographies and currencies, and flagging discrepancies Document processes end-to-end and support SOX readiness, responding to internal and external audit requests as the preparer with full traceability from source to output Identify manual, error-prone steps and automate them — including with AI-enabled tooling — partnering with Data Engineering, IT, and Fin Tech teams
What We're Looking For ~8 years of progressive accounting experience, including hands-on journal entry preparation and month-end close ownership Accounting degree with CRC or equivalent professional qualification (CPA-equivalent) Solid working knowledge of US GAAP; hands-on ASC 606 revenue recognition experience is a major plus Strong SQL skills — able to write and adapt queries against large-scale data warehouses (Big Query or similar) Proficiency with an ERP system (Net Suite, SAP, Oracle or similar): chart of accounts, journal entry posting, validation, and drill-down analysis Experience supporting internal or external audits; exposure to SOX controls and documentation Fluent English — this role works daily with a US-based team during Eastern Time hours
Nice to Have Big 4 or large multinational (Fortune 500-scale) background; IPO or public company readiness experience Industry experience with complex, high-volume revenue models (tech/marketplace, retail, media, manufacturing) Experience with data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau) and scripting for automation
Who Thrives Here Someone gritty and curious who gets into the weeds, asks questions, and comes with proposed solutions. We're moving fast toward a bigger goal: priorities pivot, hours can stretch during peak periods, and feedback is direct. If you like ambiguity, ownership, and building processes that didn't exist yesterday, you'll fit right in!
What we offer Competitive compensation package Comprehensive medical insurance coverage. Meal allowance Dental Insurance Hybrid setting Opportunity for advancement and upward mobility within the organization, allowing for increased levels of responsibility and growth within the company
